The excerpt from the beginning of the book shows that the book begins with a definition of God and the Messenger of God, Muhammad, and then moves on to mention the importance of leadership and politics in Islam, the necessity of the presence of an imam and governors, and the duty of obedience and loyalty to them. The book aims to facilitate understanding of Sharia politics and judiciary, and seeks to provide clear evidence of the importance of these topics in Islam.
descriptions.2198: The book “Good Conduct, the Preserver of the State of Kings” by Ibn al-Mawsili is considered one of the important books in the field of Sharia politics and the judiciary, as it discusses the concepts of justice and benevolence and their effects on governance and politics. The book provides a comprehensive vision of the importance of justice in preserving the state and the king, and presents principles and methods for achieving justice in governance, including consultation, leniency, and abandoning harshness. The book emphasizes the role of justice in the well-being of the nation and the continuity of states, and provides practical advice to rulers and governors on how to achieve justice in their rule. The book is a valuable resource for discussions on Sharia politics and judiciary, and presents a comprehensive Islamic view on governance and politics.
descriptions.2199: The book “Pearls of Rulers in the Explanation of Al-Ahkam Magazine” by Ali Haider is an encyclopedic explanation of the Al-Ahkam Al-Adliyya Magazine, and is located in the field of Sharia politics and the judiciary. The book begins with two introductory articles: the first in defining the science of jurisprudence and dividing it into acts of worship, transactions, marriages, and punishments, and the second in explaining the general jurisprudential rules that form the basis of rulings, such as “matters according to their objectives,” “certainty is not removed by doubt,” and “there is neither harm nor harm.” Through this explanation, the author aims to detail the practical jurisprudential issues deduced from their detailed evidence, with a focus on transactions that occur frequently.
descriptions.2200: This book, “Pearls of Behavior in the Politics of Kings,” by Al-Mawardi, deals with the topics of Sharia politics and the judiciary. The author focuses on good morals and royal policies, reviewing the virtues of morals and ways to reform reprehensible morals. He also talks about how man rules for himself and how kings rule their subjects. The book also deals with concepts such as serenity and dignity, patience, keeping secrets, advice, and corresponding morals in kings, with an emphasis on the importance of setting a good example for kings in ruling their subjects.
descriptions.2201: This book is considered a treatise within “A Collection on Politics” by the Moroccan Minister, and is classified within the field of Sharia politics and the judiciary. The book deals with multiple topics related to Sharia politics, such as types of policies, obedience to God, justice and benevolence, reforming the morals of the elite, inspecting the conditions of the elite, and the characteristics of the ruler with the elite. The book shows an interest in improving Sharia policy and its application in daily life, with an emphasis on the importance of reforming oneself and dealing with subjects with justice and benevolence. The book provides a comprehensive vision on how to apply Sharia politics in various aspects of life, including personal and community relationships.
descriptions.2202: The book “Messengers of Kings and Those Fit for Message and Embassy” is a book that is classified within the field of Sharia politics and judiciary, and is considered an important reference for understanding the role of messengers in Islam. The book begins by mentioning the importance of the messengers in Islam, and indicates the necessity of the right to venerate them and submit to them. It also provides examples from the Holy Qur’an about mentioning the messengers. The book also covers topics such as the names of the messengers of the Messenger of God ﷺ, the obligation of the right to venerate them, the obligation of the right to obey them, and the benefit of sending messengers. The book shows the importance of messengers in Islam, and explains how they were chosen, their duties, and their attributes. The book is a valuable source of information about the messengers in Islam, and provides a comprehensive view of their role in Islamic society.
descriptions.2203: This is a book on Sharia politics and the judiciary, describing the fees of the Abbasid Caliphate and the etiquette of service there. It deals with the laws of hijab, accompanying the caliphs in processions, removing tradition and honour, and the caliphs’ speech in books and supplications for them, in addition to the fees for sermons on pulpits and the beating of drums during prayer times. The author aims to document the traditions and ceremonies that were established at work in the court of the Caliphate.
descriptions.2204: The book Siraj Al-Muluk by Abu Bakr Al-Tartushi is a book that falls under the classification of Sharia politics and judiciary, and is concerned with studying aspects of governance and politics in the Islamic framework. The book covers various topics, such as the sermons of kings, the positions of scholars and righteous people, governors and judges, in addition to discussing the qualities that a Muslim ruler must possess, such as justice and mercy. The book shows an interest in understanding the nature of governance and authority in Islamic society, with an emphasis on the importance of justice and piety in maintaining social order. The book provides a comprehensive view on how Islamic principles can be applied in governance and politics, making it a valuable resource for understanding Sharia politics in Islam.
descriptions.2205: This book, “Siyasat Nama or the Lives of Kings,” by Nizam al-Mulk, is considered one of the most important historical sources in the field of Sharia politics and the judiciary. The book contains a table of contents that includes many chapters that deal with various topics such as royal biography, judges, preachers, muhtasib, and justice of the Persian kings. The book begins with an introduction by the author of the book, which explains the reasons for writing the book and details its contents. The book is an important source for historical and political study in the Islamic era, and is considered one of the most important books that dealt with the subject of Sharia politics and the judiciary.
descriptions.2206: The book “Explanation of Sir Al-Kabir” by its author Al-Sarkhasi is considered one of the important books in the field of Sharia politics and the judiciary, as it covers multiple topics related to war, politics and the judiciary. The book begins with the commentator’s introduction, which talks about the importance of the book and the reason for its classification, then addresses topics such as Rabat, the Emirate, the dispatch of the companies, banners and brigades, supplication in war, and fighting during the sacred months. The book shows the importance of understanding Sharia politics and judiciary in Islamic societies, and provides valuable insights into how Sharia rulings are applied in various circumstances.
descriptions.2207: The Fruit of the Caliphs and the Fruit of the Extremes or the Message of Marzban (in Persian: Marzbannameh) is a book in the Tabariyya language from the fourth century AH, written by Marzban bin Rustam Al-Farimi. There is no copy of the original language of the book The Satrap Letter. There are translations into Persian, Turkish and Arabic. Shihab al-Din Ibn Arabshah translated this book into Arabic and called it Fruit of the Caliphs and Fruit of the Caliphs and Fruit of the Extremes.
descriptions.2208: This book, “Ma’athir al-Infa fi Ma’alim al-Khilafah” by al-Qalqashandi, deals with the history of the Islamic caliphate and its development throughout the ages, focusing on the Rightly Guided Caliphs and the Umayyads. The author studies how the caliphs are attributed to the supreme caliph and how the Islamic state was administered under their rule, focusing on the political and judicial incidents and governors in the provinces during their rule. The book aims to shed light on the deeds and blessings that characterized the period of the Caliphate, while pointing out the importance of the Caliphate in preserving the religion, protecting sanctities, and preserving Sharia law.
descriptions.2209: This book, “A Collection of Political Documents of the Prophet’s Era and the Caliphate,” by Muhammad Hamidullah, is considered one of the most important historical sources that provides detailed information about the Prophet’s era and the Rightly Guided Caliphate. The book contains a collection of political documents that were collected and analyzed by studying different narratives and the language used in the documents. The book covers various periods of the Prophet’s era, including the period before the Hijra and the period after the Hijra, and includes a group of documents such as the first, second and third Pledge of Aqaba, the letter of the Ansar to the Messenger of God, the book of Aman by Suraqa bin Malik al-Madlaji, and the prohibition of Medina and its liberation. The book is an important source for the historical and political study of the Prophet's era and the Rightly Guided Caliphate, and provides useful information about the administrative and political system established by the Prophet Muhammad ﷺ.
descriptions.2210: In his political memoirs, Sultan Abdul Hamid II presents his vision of his rule and the challenges of the Ottoman Empire, speaking about internal events and external conspiracies, and reviewing issues such as nationalist movements, the Armenian crisis, and bureaucratic corruption. The book also addresses relations with the great powers and the economic and social challenges the country faced, with a focus on the role of minorities in governance and administration.
descriptions.2211: The book “The Signs of Proximity in Requesting Hisbah” by the writer Ibn al-Akhwa provides a comprehensive study in the field of legal policy and the judiciary, as it deals with the concepts of hisbah and the roles of the muhtasib in terms of conditions and duties. It reviews chapters on enjoining good and forbidding evil, accounting for forbidden instruments, funerals, and non-Muslims, in addition to issues of tax and usury. The text aims to guide the reader to the application of Sharia rulings in the management of public and economic affairs in accordance with the approach of the Salaf, based on the Prophet’s hadiths.
descriptions.2212: Mu'in al-Hikam, regarding the rulings that are circulated between the two opponents, by Al-Tarabulsi is a book specializing in legal policy and the judiciary. It explains the reality of the judiciary, its meaning, its wisdom, and its virtue in achieving justice. It reviews the roles and tasks of judges, representatives, hisbah, arbitration, messengers, collection, and partial functions related to the judiciary. It also addresses the pillars of the judiciary, from the descriptions and conditions for the validity of a judge’s mandate to what is necessary in his biography, his seat, and his residence, based on legal evidence that shows the status of the judiciary as a supreme prophetic position that raises the status of justice, determines interests, and prevents corruption.
descriptions.2213: Nisab Al-Ihtisab by Al-Sanami falls under the classification of Sharia politics and the judiciary, and aims to clarify the concept of Ihtisab and detail its provisions in Sharia. The author explains the interpretation of the two commonly used terms “Hisbah” and “Hisbah” and reviews multiple issues, including hisbah regarding speech, actions, judges, cemeteries, women, the poor, the oppressors, and other daily situations. It also explains the differences between the appointed muhtasib and the volunteer muhtasib and provides answers on the topics of discretionary punishment and disputes between neighbors. The book is considered a jurisprudential reference to guide jurists and scholars in matters of imputation.
descriptions.2214: The system of proof in Islamic jurisprudence is considered one of the important aspects of Sharia policy and judiciary, as it is concerned with studying and analyzing the foundations of proof in Islamic jurisprudence. The book points out the importance of the judiciary in Islam, as it is considered a fundamental pillar in maintaining social order, and shows how Islamic law has dealt with the judiciary from the beginning. The book covers multiple topics such as acknowledgment, testimony, the origin of testimony and its ruling, in addition to a comparison between jurisprudence and law on the subject of testimony, the oath of oath, the knowledge of the judge, and judgment based on physiognomy and evidence. The book shows the importance of the proof system in Islamic jurisprudence in maintaining justice and rights in Islamic society.
descriptions.2215: The book “Nihayat al-Ratbah al-Darifa fi Taal al-Hisbah al-Sharifa” by al-Shaizri is concerned with detailing the rulings on the Shari’a hisbah and guiding the hastibas to its conditions and desirables. In its parts, it reviews the necessary knowledge of markets, methods, measurements, and weight, in addition to its guidance for those dealing in various crafts such as bakers, surgeons, pharmacists, and others. The book is classified under Sharia politics and the judiciary, and through its chapters it shows the muhtasib’s commitment to the Sunnah of the Messenger, gentleness of speech, and ease of morals, with a focus on controlling prices and determining weights according to Sharia standards.
descriptions.2216: This book deals with the subject of applying legal limits in Islamic law, and reviews the virtues of establishing these limits and their legal and rational evidence, while warning against abandoning them. It also responds to those who deny some legal punishments, such as stoning, and compares legal punishments with statutory punishments, explaining the goals of legal punishments and the harms of statutory punishments. The book is a classification of Sharia politics and judiciary.
descriptions.2217: The book “Introducing the Prophet of Mercy” by Thaer Salama falls within the biography of the Prophet and his virtues, and aims to clarify the status of the Prophet Muhammad ﷺ by reviewing his majestic and human qualities. The author relies on texts from the Sunnah of the Prophet and the sayings of the Companions to demonstrate the beauty of his qualities and his uniqueness as an interpreter of the Qur’an, and he relies on the table of contents, which includes references to Anas, Moaz, Ibn Abi Hala, and others. The book concludes with a statement highlighting the role of the Prophet in guiding people and revealing the meanings of the Qur’an.
descriptions.2218: This book is a comprehensive research on the biography of the Prophet, as it focuses on the importance of studying and documenting the biography of the Prophet Muhammad ﷺ. The author shows that studying the Prophet’s biography is of great importance in the path of human life, as it is possible through it to imitate the Prophet’s biography and apply the provisions of Islam and its law. The author also highlights the importance of documenting the biography of the Prophet ﷺ through its original sources, such as the Holy Qur’an and the Sunnah of the Prophet, to ensure the truthfulness of his prophecy ﷺ. The book also shows that knowing the details of the Prophet ﷺ’s biography is essential to benefit from his experience and follow his example in all matters of life.
descriptions.2219: The book “A Mercy to the Worlds” by Saeed bin Wahf Al-Qahtani is concerned with the biography of the Prophet Muhammad, peace and blessings be upon him, and his moral characteristics. It is divided into chapters that deal with his lineage, birth, and death, his upbringing under God’s care, his calling and his miracle of the Night Journey and Mi’raj, then his moral and worship qualities from prayer and fasting to asceticism and piety, with lessons and lessons learned. It is based on Qur’anic and Hadith texts to show how the Prophet was a mercy to mankind and the jinn, and an example to be followed in morals and worship.
descriptions.2220: The book “Replying Suspicions About the Infallibility of the Prophet ﷺ” deals with responding to the doubts raised about the infallibility of the Prophet Muhammad ﷺ, and the author, Imad Al-Sayyid Muhammad Ismail Al-Sherbini, provides a comprehensive vision on this subject, explaining the importance of the Prophet’s biography in understanding Islam and responding to those who doubt the infallibility of the Prophet. The book examines issues such as the infallibility of the Prophet ﷺ in his mind and body, repelling suspicions about Satan’s control over him, and his sufficiency from him, and shows that the suspicions of the enemies of Islam about the infallibility of the Prophet are based on denying his prophethood. The book shows the importance of understanding the Prophet’s biography in proving the status of the Prophet ﷺ and his favor with his Lord, and responds to those who consider that similar verses in the Holy Qur’an indicate his infallibility. The book provides an in-depth vision on this important topic in Islam, and is considered an important reference for researchers and those interested in the subject of the Prophet’s biography and the infallibility of the Prophet Muhammad ﷺ.
descriptions.2221: The book “A Reading of the Purdah of al-Busayri and His Poetry” by the writer Alawi al-Saqqaf is concerned with studying the poem “The Prophet’s Burdah” by Sheikh al-Busayri, shedding light on the poet’s biography, personal characteristics, and the use of his poetry in seeking safety from people. It also deals with the spread of the text and its influence on Sufi practices and worship. This work falls within the classification of biography and shama’il, as it combines literary and graphic analysis of the poem with details of its author’s life.
descriptions.2222: This book deals with the biography of the Prophet Muhammad ﷺ in detail, focusing on his lineage, upbringing, and the events of his early life in Mecca. The author deals with important events, such as the story of the elephant, the split of the chest, and his travels to the Levant, relying on multiple sources, including biographical books, interpretations of the Qur’an, and books of hadith. The book aims to present a comprehensive and documented picture of the life of the Prophet and his message, with a comparison between different historical narratives and the opinions of orientalists.
descriptions.2223: This book, “The Prophet’s Ethics and Etiquette,” by Sheikh Al-Asbahani, is considered one of the most important sources in the science of the Prophet’s biography and prophetic virtues. The book is concerned with studying the morals of the Prophet Muhammad ﷺ, and analyzing his high qualities, such as his generosity and great tolerance, his extreme shyness, his forgiveness, his presence and generosity, his courage, his humility, the signs of his contentment and the signs of his discontent, his turning a blind eye to what he hated, his kindness to his nation, his suppression of anger and forbearance, the quality of his crying and sadness, the quality of his logic and words, and the quality of his walking. And he turned around, and mentioned what he said when he got up from his sitting, and mentioned his love for perfume and using it, and the description of the dress of the Messenger of God ﷺ, and he mentioned his shirt and praised his Lord when he put it on, and he mentioned the time of his dressing when he begged for it, and he mentioned his garment, and he mentioned his garment and clothing, and the description of his robe, and he mentioned his suit, and he mentioned his cloak, and he mentioned his turban, and he mentioned his hood, and he mentioned his trousers, and he mentioned his wool, and he mentioned his clothing of linen, cotton, and yamna.
descriptions.2224: The book “The most correct tidings in the mission of the master of the first and the last” by Sheikh Muhammad Al-Majzoub is considered an important work that falls under the classification of biography and virtues, as it presents a comprehensive study on the mission of the Messenger of God ﷺ and the great message that he carried. The book shows an interest in studying the tidings presented for the Messenger ﷺ's mission, focusing on the most important aspects of the related subject, including his Universal Declaration of the Human Rights to Life, Dignity and Liberty. The book provides in-depth insight into this important topic, making it a valuable source of information about the noble Prophet’s biography.
descriptions.2225: This book, “Importants of the Prophethood” by Al-Mawardi, is a book on the biography and virtues of the Prophet Muhammad ﷺ through a comprehensive study of his characteristics and attributes. The book begins by introducing the author and the sheikhs he heard from, then moves to the author’s introduction, which explains the importance of prophecy and introducing God to be worshipped. This is followed by the first chapter in the introduction to evidence, which deals with the study of the science of acquisition, necessity, evidence, the rulings of reason, and the rulings of hearing. Then comes the second chapter on knowing the worshiped God, which deals with what Christians say and the meaning of oneness. This is followed by the third chapter on the validity of the assignment, which deals with definitions of the assignment, the obligation of the assignment, the legitimacy of the assignment, the command and will, the conditions for the validity of the command, and the time of the command. It appears from this book that Al-Mawardi was one of the most important figures of jurisprudence, language, and thought in the Abbasid era, and that his book is considered one of the most important sources in the study of the Prophet’s biography and virtues.
descriptions.2226: The Millennium of the Prophet’s Biography, called Nazm al-Durar al-Sunniyyah fi al-Siyar al-Zakiyya, a poetic collection of the Prophet’s biography written by the hadith scholar, Hafiz Abd al-Rahim al-Iraqi, at the end of his life in Medina. He says at the beginning:
descriptions.2227: The book “The Model of the Intellectual in the Characteristics of the Beloved” by Al-Suyuti is considered one of the important books in the field of biography and virtues, as it is concerned with studying the characteristics that the Prophet Muhammad ﷺ distinguished from the rest of the prophets. The book provides a comprehensive overview of these characteristics, and shows the importance of studying them for understanding the position of the Prophet Muhammad ﷺ. The book is divided into sections and chapters that address various aspects of the characteristics of the Prophet ﷺ, making it a valuable resource for those interested in studying the Prophet’s biography.
descriptions.2228: This book deals with the study of the Prophet’s biography from an educational perspective, focusing on the role of the Prophet Muhammad ﷺ as the greatest teacher and educator. The author focuses on the Messenger’s interest in education, and refers to the topics, methods, and means of education in the Prophet’s biography. The book aims to highlight the importance of studying the Prophet’s biography for teachers and developing their educational performance in the present era.
descriptions.2229: This book addresses the importance of studying the Prophet’s biography in the lives of Muslims from various perspectives, including religious, social, political, economic, and military aspects. The author focuses on the religious importance of the Prophet’s biography as a source of guidance and Islamic teachings, and points out its role in guiding Muslims in all areas of life. The book also deals with how the Prophet ﷺ taught and raised the Companions, and dealt with social, economic, political and military issues, relying on the Prophet’s biography as a basic reference.
descriptions.2230: The book “The Early Authors on the Prophet’s Biography” by Sheikh Abd al-Shafi Muhammad Abd al-Latif is concerned with studying the origins and composition of the Prophet’s biography by reviewing the layers of writing and the names of the pioneers who laid the foundations of this field. It details the motivations of Muslims to be interested in the biography of the Prophet and provides a historical introduction that explains the beginning of the composition. The content includes chapters that classify authors into first, second, and third classes, mentioning their names and deeds in books on conquests and biographies, providing the reader with a comprehensive overview of the contributions of early writers in documenting the biography of the Prophet, peace and blessings be upon him.
descriptions.2231: A book on the biography and virtues of the Prophet, dealing with the educational personality of the Prophet ﷺ and his missionary function in teaching his companions the Holy Qur’an. The author examines the Prophetic methodology for teaching Quranic pronunciation, and analyzes the implications of the overall and detailed mission of the Messenger, with a focus on its branches such as recitation, teaching, and recommendation. The book aims to show the role of the Prophet and the teacher and explain how he dealt with his companions in receiving and understanding the Qur’an.
descriptions.2232: This book deals with the letters of the Prophet Muhammad ﷺ to kings and presidents, explaining their various goals and implications. The author focuses on presenting the messages in chronological and historical order, mentioning the responses of the People of the Book to them wherever they appear. The book is a type of historical and jurisprudential book that deals with the life of the Prophet and his methods of communicating with kings and rulers.
descriptions.2233: Entertaining the listeners with the status and wealth of the Prophet is a work by Al-Maqrizi that is classified within the biography of the Prophet and his virtues. It collects hadiths and reports that deal with the Prophet’s conditions, possessions, and exploits, with introductions and supplications that aim to entertain the listeners and enrich their knowledge of his fragrant biography. It also includes chapters that address various topics from the history of the construction of the Kaaba to doctrinal differences, making it a reference for researchers of Islamic heritage.
descriptions.2234: Illuminating the Darkness in the Conquests of Khair Al-Wari is a scientific explanation of a poetic system that deals with the Conquests of the Prophet ﷺ, prepared by the scholar and specialist jurist Hassan bin Muhammad Mashat. The book includes a translation of the original text and a systematic study that includes clarifying the geographical locations of the events, verifying conflicting narratives, and highlighting the jurisprudential aspects and lessons learned. It also links historical facts with their spiritual purposes, based on the system’s explanations and sources, to provide a comprehensive vision of the Prophet’s biography and the virtues of his battles.
descriptions.2235: This book, “Al-Anwar fi Shamail al-Nabi al-Mukhtar” by Al-Baghawi, is a book on the classification of biography and virtues. It contains multiple chapters that deal with the attributes of the Prophet Muhammad ﷺ, from his choice in the preceding to his attributes in the Resurrection. It also includes topics such as the signs of his prophecy, his miracles, his names, his attributes, his hair, his gray hair, his pleasant smell, his forbearance, his forgiveness, his turning away from what he hated, his gentleness in matters, and his dignity, His apology, his awe, his pity, his crying, his anger at God, his happiness, his laughter, his joking, his action when he sneezes, his modesty, the quality of his speech, his silence, his speech in a language other than the Arabic language, his listening to poetry, his courage, his presence, his humility, his asceticism, and his turning away from the world.
descriptions.2236: The brief dictation in Sharh Gharib al-Sir by Sheikh Jurist Abu Dhar al-Khushani is a book that combines the biography of the Prophet Muhammad ﷺ with an explanation of the linguistic and grammatical oddities mentioned in it. The book quotes the novel by Abdul Malik bin Hisham and Ziyad bin Abdullah, then explains the poetic verses that carry difficult meanings while clarifying the meanings of the words and grammatical rules. It aims to shorten the explanation without disturbing the statement, adopting a concise style that combines historical narration and linguistic analysis.
descriptions.2237: The book “Being content with what it contains of the battles of the Messenger of God” by the writer Abu Al-Rabi’ Al-Kala’i falls within the classification of biography and merits, and is concerned with collecting and documenting the positions of the Prophet ﷺ and three caliphs in their battles and historical incidents. Its content includes chapters dealing with the missions of the Prophet, the Farewell Pilgrimage, the migration to Abyssinia, incidents with Khalid ibn al-Walid, and the contracts of Islam with the Banu Amir, in addition to narrating other positions such as the Quraysh, the building of the Kaaba, and the responses to various tribes. The author aims to present a documented text linking the Prophet’s biography and controversial issues by reviewing the facts and facts available in the sources.
descriptions.2238: The book “The Burdah, Explanation, Parsing, and Rhetoric for Students of Institutes and Universities” by the writer Muhammad Yahya Helu is an educational reference that specializes in detailing the Prophet’s poem Burdah. The curriculum follows explaining foreign vocabulary, clarifying the general meaning of each verse, its grammatical parsing, and extracting rhetorical images if they exist, which provides the student with a practical model in grammar and rhetoric. This work is considered part of the biography and shamail classification, and targets institute and university students who wish to deepen their understanding of the poem and its linguistic and graphic components.
descriptions.2239: It is the book “The Sufficiency of the Intelligent Student in the Characteristics of the Beloved” by Imam Jalal al-Din Abd al-Rahman al-Suyuti. The book is also known as “The Great Characteristics,” and the original name of the book is “The Sufficiency of the Intellectual Student in the Characteristics of the Beloved,” but it is famous for “The Great Characteristics.” It includes the matters that the Prophet was specific to and no one else, providing the correct evidence, and responding to fabricated texts. Among the most important topics is that he is the Seal of the Prophets, and talking about his amazing miracles.
descriptions.2240: Al-Durar fi Akhtasar Al-Maghazi wal-Sir is a book written by Yusuf bin Abdullah bin Muhammad bin Abdul-Barr bin Asim Al-Nimri Al-Qurtubi Al-Andalusi Al-Maliki. It deals with the biography of the Prophet Muhammad from his birth until his death, and also deals with his news, wars, and other things.
descriptions.2241: The book “The Islamic Call in its Meccan Era: Its Methods and Objectives” by the writer Raouf Shalabi is concerned with analyzing the foundations of the prophetic call in the Meccan era, reviewing its motivations and doctrinal components of proving the oneness of God, and contrasting that with the approach to collective work and leadership education. The author links religious concepts and social behavior, relying on the texts of the Qur’an and Sunnah to explain the conditions for happiness for the individual, family, and group. The book is classified within the biography of the Prophet and his virtues, as it presents a systematic study that shows how the Islamic call formed a spiritual and social path in the Arabian Peninsula.
descriptions.2242: This book, “The Sealed Nectar with Some Modifications and Additions,” is written by Safi al-Rahman al-Mubarakfuri in the field of biography and merits. The book deals with the biography of the Prophet Muhammad ﷺ, starting from his lineage and childhood until the beginning of the call, with the addition of some reflections and lessons to enhance the scientific and practical benefit of studying the Prophet’s biography. It also contains illustrative pictures of sites and places mentioned in the biography to facilitate understanding of the incidents and events.
descriptions.2243: The Sealed Nectar is a book on the biography of the Prophet Muhammad ﷺ, printed and published for the first time based on a study on the biography of Sheikh Safi al-Rahman al-Mubarakpuri, which he submitted as a participant in the Muslim World League’s competition on the noble biography of the Prophet, which was announced at a conference of the League in Pakistan in the year 1396 AH, and its results were announced in Shaban 1398 AH, where the research won first place out of 171 papers that were submitted, and prizes were awarded in The Association’s conference was held in Mecca in the year 1399 AH, and the General Secretariat of the Association announced that it would print the winning research and publish it in several languages. Among them was this book, which was subsequently published in multiple editions. Sheikh Al-Mubarakfouri says about it: “God has destined this book from the beginning…
descriptions.2244: The Message of Muhammad by Suleiman al-Nadawi is a book in the field of biography and virtues that highlights the biography of the prophets with a special focus on the biography of the Prophet Muhammad as an immortal role model. In its lectures, the book addresses topics such as human responsibility, the wisdom of sending messengers, the distinction of the prophetic call from others, and reviews the historical aspects of the prophetic message and memorization of hadith. It also discusses the differences between the Prophet’s biography and other biographies and highlights the role of the Companions and followers in transmitting the Prophet’s heritage.
descriptions.2245: This book, “The Leader Messenger” by author Mahmoud Sheet Khattab, is considered an important book in the classification of biography and virtues. The book deals with the military aspect of the life of the Prophet Muhammad, may God bless him and grant him peace, and aims to reveal his military genius and its functions in the history of Islam. The book shows how the Messenger, may God bless him and grant him peace, was able to establish a strong Islamic state, control its battles, and win them, without leaving any evidence of his military genius. This book is a valuable resource for researchers in the history of Islam, helps in understanding the relations between Islam and society, and reflects the influence of the Messenger, may God bless him and grant him peace, in Islamic history.
descriptions.2246: This book deals with an account of the accusations and slander directed at the Prophet Muhammad ﷺ by Western writers across different eras and generations. The author focuses on analyzing the main sources on which these accusations were based, and discusses the reasons and motives for this Western obsession with criticizing and insulting the Prophet. It also seeks to shed light on the efforts made to show the true image of the Prophet in Western societies.
descriptions.2247: Al-Rawd al-Anf fi Sharh biography of the Prophet by Ibn Hisham, called Al-Rawd al-Anf for short, is a book explaining the biography of the Prophet by its author, Abu al-Qasim al-Suhayli (508 AH - 1114 AD / 581 AH - 1185 AD).
descriptions.2248: Al-Rawd al-Anf fi Sharh biography of the Prophet by Ibn Hisham, called Al-Rawd al-Anf for short, is a book explaining the biography of the Prophet by its author, Abu al-Qasim al-Suhayli (508 AH - 1114 AD / 581 AH - 1185 AD).
descriptions.2249: This book, “The Prophet’s Convoys and Envoys around Medina and Mecca,” by Brik Al-Omari, is classified under the classification of biography and merits. The book provides a content index that includes an introduction and three sections, in addition to several chapters that deal with the prophetic missions and missions in the various stages of the history of Medina and Mecca. The book begins with an introduction that provides some advice on the importance of history and historical writings, then moves on to discuss the prophetic missions and missions, highlighting the importance of these events in the history of Medina and Mecca. The book shows an interest in Islamic history, especially the biography of the Prophet, and reflects an effort to address these events from a historical perspective.
descriptions.2250: The book “Al-Sir” by Abu Ishaq Al-Fazari is considered one of the books concerned with biography and virtues, as it contains hadiths and narrations that refer to the behavior and actions of the Companions and followers in various situations. The table of contents shows that the book covers various topics such as exhuming graves and ore, as well as topics related to sales, judiciary, and conquests. The book seems to be concerned with clarifying and interpreting legal rulings in the context of the Prophet’s biography and virtues, which makes it an important source of Islamic knowledge.
descriptions.2251: The book “The Aleppo Biography” by Sheikh Nour Al-Din Al-Halabi is the author of a biography and comprehensive texts about the life of the Prophet Muhammad ﷺ, and falls under the classification of biography and merits. It includes detailed chapters dealing with his honorable lineage, birth, childhood, travels to the Levant, his conquests, the Night Journey and Miraj, in addition to the places of revelation, migration, and death, based on multiple sources to provide a comprehensive biography. It aims to combine the correct biography and the prophetic virtues in a sequential presentation that covers the various stages of his life.
descriptions.2252: The biography of the Prophet means the biography of the Prophet Muhammad, ﷺ, and it is the science specialized in collecting what was reported from the life of the Prophet Muhammad ﷺ and his moral and moral attributes, in addition to his conquests and missions.
descriptions.2253: This book, “The Prophet’s Biography according to Al-Haythami in his book Majma’ al-Zawa’id and Manba’ al-Fawa’id,” written by A. D. Suleiman bin Abdullah Al-Suwaiket, this book is considered one of the works that dealt with the subject of the Prophet’s biography, and Al-Haythami’s Majma’ al-Zawa’id is considered a rich and inexhaustible resource of wisdom, guidance, light, and lesson. The book shows the diversity of its material and sources, as at the top of the list of these sources is the Holy Book of God, then what has been reported on the authority of the Messenger of God ﷺ or on the authority of his honorable companions that was recorded in the books of hadith. This book is considered one of the works that dealt with the subject of the Prophet’s biography, and Al-Haythami’s Majma’ al-Zawa’id is considered a rich and inexhaustible source of wisdom, guidance, light, and lesson.
descriptions.2254: This book, “The Biography of the Prophet in the Encyclopædia Britannica,” by Al-Walid bin Blihish Al-Amri, is considered a scientific research in the field of biography and virtues. The book deals with the subject of the Prophet’s biography in the Encyclopedia Britannica, specifically in the article “Muhammad: The Prophet and His Message.” The book highlights the Orientalist appeals that appear on this topic, and analyzes them from an objective scientific perspective. The book aims to expose these appeals, show them for what they are, and demonstrate their deviation from objectivity and scientific sobriety. This book is considered one of the important sources for understanding and analyzing Orientalist appeals to the Prophet’s biography.
descriptions.2255: The current book, “The Biography of the Prophet” by Abu Al-Hasan Al-Nadawi, is considered one of the important books in the field of biography and virtues, as it provides a comprehensive overview of the life of the Prophet Muhammad ﷺ. The book begins with an introduction to the Prophet’s biography, then deals with the pre-Islamic era and a general look at the religious situation in the sixth century AD, including Judaism, Christianity, the Magi, Buddhism, Brahminism, and pre-Islamic Arabia. The book shows the importance of the Prophet’s biography in understanding the life and message of the Prophet, and shows its great influence on Islamic culture. This book is considered an important reference in the biography of the Prophet. It has received great acceptance and warm welcome among scholars and university professors, and has been translated into many international languages.
descriptions.2256: The Biography of the Prophet by Ibn Hisham or the biography of Ibn Hisham is a book on the prophetic biography of the Prophet Muhammad, the Messenger of Islam, and it is considered one of the most important books on the Prophet’s biography and its main sources. It is a book by Abu Muhammad Abd al-Malik bin Hisham bin Ayyub al-Himyari al-Basri, who died in the year (218 AH). He narrated it on the authority of Muhammad bin Ishaq (d. 151 AH), after he took permission for his narration from Ziyad bin Abdullah al-Bakai (d. 183 AH), and he conducted it. Ibn Hisham made some additions and deletions to Ibn Ishaq, as he refined it, and Ibn Hisham deleted many of the stories of the Israelites and the plagiarized poetry until the biography was known under the name Ibn Hisham, and researchers paid attention to it, and many explanations and abbreviations were written on it.
descriptions.2257: This book is a translation of the purified biography of the Prophet Muhammad ﷺ written by Imam Ibn Kathir, as it deals with the life of the Prophet and the events of the Islamic call, relying on accurate narration of Islamic news and history. The book begins by presenting the conditions of the Arabs in pre-Islamic times and moves on to mention the lineage of the Prophet and the events of his blessed life, passing through the period of birth and breastfeeding and his witnesses to the pre-Islamic wars, all the way to the beginning of the revelation. The book aims to present the biography of the Prophet in an accurate and objective manner, relying on examining the narratives and criticizing their evidence.
descriptions.2258: The book “The Prophet’s Biography, a Methodology for Studying it and Reviewing its Events” by the writer Abdul Rahman Ali Al-Hajji falls within the classification of biography and merits, and is concerned with providing a systematic framework for understanding the biography of the Prophet, peace and blessings be upon him, and its historical and jurisprudential components. In his chapters, the author addresses topics such as the sources of studying biography, the method of writing biography between jurisprudence and history, and its impact on society and the righteous generation. It also sheds light on ways to express biography and its components in terms of deep understanding and imitation, based on Qur’anic texts and references to the values ​​of faith and work.
descriptions.2259: The book The Biography of the Prophet and News of the Caliphs by Ibn Hibban is a book in the field of biography and virtues that combines the biography of the Prophet Muhammad ﷺ and the news of the Rightly Guided Caliphs. It includes an account of the events of his birth, his prophecies, his migration, and the invasions, in addition to directions for adhering to the Sunnah of the Prophet and the Sunnah of the Rightly Guided Caliphs and an urge to spread knowledge. It aims to document the history of the hadith scholars and remind the reader of the importance of memorizing the Sunnahs and avoiding innovations.
descriptions.2260: The Prophet’s Biography and Dawah in the Civil Era” by the writer Ahmed Ahmad Ghalush falls under the classification of biography and virtues, and focuses on the stage of the migration to Medina and the establishment of the Islamic state there. The book deals with the details of the migration, the Prophet’s settlement in Medina, the organization of Islamic society in terms of brotherhood and covenant, in addition to the Prophet’s family life and the polygamy of his wives. It also reviews the impact of revelation in directing Sharia and morals during this period.
descriptions.2261: The book “The Prophet’s Biography and Dawah in the Meccan Era” by Ahmad Ahmad Ghalush presents a comprehensive study of the global reality before the emergence of Islam, then moves to the biography of the Prophet Muhammad ﷺ from his noble lineage to the stages of his youth, marriage, and the building of the Kaaba, with a focus on the revenues of the Prophet’s preaching in Mecca. The author combines analysis of ancient religions and peoples such as the Arabs, Romans, Persians, and Indians, and reviews the reasons for the spread of religious error and human aspirations for a new messenger. The book is classified under the category of biography and virtues, which makes it a reference for understanding the historical and advocacy context of the prophetic message in the Meccan period.
descriptions.2262: The biography of the Prophet means the biography of the Prophet Muhammad, ﷺ, and it is the science specialized in collecting what was reported from the life of the Prophet Muhammad ﷺ and his moral and moral attributes, in addition to his conquests and missions.
descriptions.2263: Al-Shifa by Defining the Rights of the Chosen One by the scholar Al-Qadi Ayyad is a book on the biography and virtues of the Prophet that aims to clarify the rights of the Chosen One by praising God Almighty for him and enumerating his virtues and attributes. It includes chapters dealing with divine praise, dignity, eloquence, good character, mercy, justice and other prophetic qualities. The text is accompanied by Al-Shamni's footnote, which clarifies and disambiguates the terminology of healing, adding a detailed explanation of the topics mentioned. The book is a reference for those searching for the biography of the Prophet and his moral and spiritual components.
descriptions.2264: Al-Shifa by Defining the Rights of the Chosen One, a book about the virtues of the Prophet Muhammad, written by Judge Ayyad Musa Al-Yahsbi Al-Sabti (476 AH - 544 AH), and it is considered one of the best books introducing the Prophet Muhammad. In it, the scholars said: “If it were not for Al-Shifa, the Chosen One would not have been known.” Some Mauritanian scholars used to read it in the month of Rabi’ al-Awwal in their gatherings. Its author divided it into four sections: the first on glorifying the status of the Prophet in word and deed, the second on what rights are obligatory upon his servants, the third on what is impossible for him, what is permissible, what is forbidden, and what is valid, and the fourth is on disposing of the aspects of rulings on those who disparage or insult him. It is an encyclopedic book, and it is considered one of the most wonderful books that introduced the Prophet Muhammad ﷺ and his attributes, rights, and virtues. …
descriptions.2265: Al-Shamā’il al-Sharifā’ by Suyuti is a book of the type of biography and shāma’īl that specializes in defining Imam al-Manawi and demonstrating his noble qualities. It includes the introduction to the work, the introduction to the commentator, and then a chapter dedicated to al-Shamā’il al-Sharifa. The book focuses on the biography of Imam al-Manawi, the scholar of religion and arts, and presents a group of his definitions and discussions that demonstrate his scientific and spiritual status. This work is considered a reference in documenting the biography of one of the most prominent scholars and detailing the features of his virtuous personality.
descriptions.2266: Al-Shama’il al-Muhammadiyah wa al-Khaya’il al-Mustafawiyyah is a book in which Imam al-Tirmidhi collected hadiths dealing with the attributes of the Prophet Muhammad ﷺ in terms of character, appearance, clothing, and etiquette. It includes detailed chapters that talk about his character, the seal of prophethood, his hair, his walk, his clothing, his food, his tools, and other characteristics mentioned in the hadiths. This work falls within the classification of biography and virtues, and relies on multiple narrations to provide a comprehensive picture of the Prophet’s biography and characteristics.
descriptions.2267: The Science of Shama’il Muhammadiyah Shama’il Muhammadiyah (Book)
descriptions.2268: The book “Prayers upon the Prophet ﷺ, its virtues and methods” by Sheikh Abd al-Muhsin al-Abbad deals with the meaning of prayers upon the Prophet and an explanation of how to perform it, based on what has been mentioned about its virtues in the legal texts. It includes an introduction that explains the importance of praying for the Prophet in faith, and chapters that address its virtue and the fabricated hadiths that the author wrote, in addition to examples of hadiths related to the topic. The book falls within the classification of biography and virtues, as it links the biography of the Prophet and the place of prayer in the life of a Muslim.
descriptions.2269: This is a book on the biography and virtues, written by Al-Hafiz Shams Al-Din Al-Sakhawi, and in it he collected the names of those who were affiliated with the Prophet ﷺ from his servants and loyalists, mentioning the names of the men and women among them, with details in their numbers and an explanation of who among them were slaves and free. The author indicated that their total was approximately one hundred and thirty souls, mentioning those who disagreed and those whose names were multiple.
descriptions.2270: This book, “Chapters on the Biography,” by Ibn Katheer, deals with the biography of the Prophet Muhammad ﷺ and his conquests, explaining his lineage, upbringing, and origin, and documents important events such as the Hijra and Pledge of Allegiance, and the conquests of Badr, the Night Journey, and the Mi’raj. The author focuses on providing historical information and important events in the life of the Prophet and his assistants, relying on the historical sources available in his time. The book aims to provide a comprehensive historical reference to the Prophet’s biography, summarizing the main events while maintaining their precise chronological order.
descriptions.2271: The book, “The Pink Poem in the Biography of Khair al-Bariyyah,” written by Abdul Karim Bayara, is considered within the classification of biography and virtues, as it presents poetic compositions about the biography of the Prophet Muhammad ﷺ. The book begins with an introduction that praises God and sends prayers upon the Prophet, then deals with various topics such as the birth of the Prophet and his honorable lineage, the arrival of revelation to him, the Night Journey and Mi’raj, his migration, and the building of the mosque. The book shows a deep appreciation for the Prophet's biography and focuses on the virtues of the Prophet Muhammad ﷺ, emphasizing his message and the generality of his call to humanity.
descriptions.2272: A book on the biography of the Prophet, which begins by presenting the conditions of Mecca and the Arabs before Islam, then deals with the biography of the Prophet Muhammad ﷺ from his birth, childhood, and youth until the beginning of the call, relying on various narrations and news. The researcher was concerned with examining the hadiths and narrations and clarifying the correct ones from the weak ones, while commenting on some of the opinions and interpretations contained in the text.
descriptions.2273: This is the book “The Great Summary of the Prophet’s Biography” by the author Izz al-Din Ibn Jama’ah, and it falls within the classification of biography and virtues. The book contains a table of contents covering various aspects of the life of the Prophet ﷺ, from his lineage and names to his biography, morals, and miracles. The book begins by defining the Messenger ﷺ and explaining his lineage and names, then moving on to describing his birth, mother and father, then telling the story of his sending ﷺ and mentioning his two migrations to Abyssinia, then moving on to mentioning his ﷺ conquests in Medina and mentioning his character, morals and miracles. The author relies on multiple sources in his writing, including biographical and historical books, and deliberately limits himself to what is agreed upon regarding the manuscripts and history of the battles.
descriptions.2274: The book deals with Orientalists and the prophetic biography of the Prophet Muhammad ﷺ, focusing on analyzing Western positions on biography throughout the ages, showing how Muslims deal with it through a network of axioms and axioms that have been rooted in their awareness through religious and social traditions. The author points out that Orientalist studies often deviate from these axioms and raise doubt and debate about the facts that Muslims consider as axioms, which arouses in them a feeling of disgust and aversion. The book aims to examine how these studies affect the Islamic understanding of the Prophet’s biography, and examines the exaggeration of doubt, slander, and denial, the adoption of weak narratives, and the attempt to link the biography’s data to Christian or Jewish origins.
descriptions.2275: This is the book “The Bright Lamp in the Book of the Unlettered Prophet and His Messengers” by the author Ibn Hudaydah. It is classified under the classification of biography and merits. The book is considered one of the most important historical sources that dealt with the life of the Prophet Muhammad ﷺ and his letters to the Arab and non-Arab kings of the earth. The book contains a comprehensive table of contents that shows its organization and the author's approach to the topics. The book begins by mentioning the names of the Prophet Muhammad ﷺ and their interpretation, then moves on to discuss the life of the Prophet ﷺ through the narratives of the Companions, including his conversion to Islam and his letters to the kings of the earth. The book shows the author's interest in interpreting the strange and the Arabic language in the narratives of the Companions, making it a valuable source for historical and linguistic studies.
descriptions.2276: Al-Maghazi or (The Conquests of Al-Waqidi) is a book written by Abu Abdullah Muhammad bin Omar bin Waqid Al-Sahmi, known as Al-Waqidi. In it, Al-Waqidi collected the stories of the conquests of the Messenger of God ﷺ and his secrets1. The book Al-Maghazi by Al-Waqidi consists of three parts. In this book, Al-Waqidi chronicled many early Islamic historical events that were not chronicled by other historians such as Ibn Ishaq.
descriptions.2277: This is the book “Al-Muqtafa from the Biography of the Chosen One ﷺ” by the author Ibn Habib Al-Halabi. It is classified under the classification of biography and virtues. The book is considered one of the most important historical sources that dealt with the biography of the Prophet Muhammad ﷺ, specifically the period of his early life. The book begins by mentioning the lineage of the Prophet ﷺ, then moves on to describe his life, including his birth, marriage, death of his father, his grandfather’s sponsorship for him, Abu Talib’s inclusion of the Prophet ﷺ, mentioning the eight predecessors to the faith, the demonstration of the call, the command of Quraysh with Abu Talib, the story of Hamza bin Abdul Muttalib, the story of Omar bin Al Khattab, the story of Badhan, king of Yemen, the story of Tufayl bin Amr Al Dusi, and the story of Rukanah bin Abdul Yazid. Al-Muttalabi, and he mentioned the immigrants to Abyssinia first and second, and the command of the Sahifa and the people in Muharram, and the departure of the Prophet ﷺ to Taif. The book is an important source for learning about the life of the Prophet ﷺ, and helps the reader understand the importance of his biography and its impact on Islamic history.
descriptions.2278: The Worldly Gifts of Muhammadiyah Grants in the Prophet’s Biography is a book of the Prophet’s biography, written by Sheikh Shihab al-Din al-Qastalani (851 AH - 923 AH). The book as a whole is a comprehensive collection of the purified Prophet’s biography according to its chronological sequence, beginning with the birth of the noble Prophet and ending with his death. The author included in his book Battles, Convoys, Resurrections, and Delegations, and then talked about the qualities of the Prophet, his characteristics, and the beauty of his creation. His creation, his companions, his wives, his concubines, his servants, his riding, his weapons, his types of clothing, and his miracles. The pages of the book reached 1536 pages in three volumes.
descriptions.2279: The book “Prophecy: Selection and Role Model” by Sheikh Ahmed Mukhtar Al-Bazra is considered a comprehensive study on the concept of prophecy and the prophetic message, as it examines God’s preparation of His messengers to carry out their mission, and deals with the psychological and social aspects that helped the messenger to carry out his message. The book shows how a person can find a role model in the life of the Prophet and his message, and examines how to apply this role model in contemporary life. The book is classified as biography and virtues, and it provides a comprehensive vision about the role of prophecy in directing humanity towards goodness and truth.
descriptions.2280: Dr. Muhammad al-Sayyid al-Wakil, in his book “The Prophet’s Migration - Study and Analysis,” provides a deep analytical view of the Prophet’s migration, considering it as a difficult experience and a great challenge for the Prophet Muhammad and his companions, and not just a trip or outing. The author focuses on the psychological and moral aspects of migration, explaining how it was a painful and distressing experience for the Prophet and his companions, while maintaining their faith and steadfastness in the truth. The book deals with immigration as a means to achieve a religious and moral goal, and not as an opportunity for rest or recreation, focusing on the sacrifices and challenges that immigrants faced on this historical journey.
descriptions.2281: The book “Badr al-Kubra” by Sheikh Muhammad Attiya Salem is a book that falls under the classification of biography and virtues, and is concerned with studying the Battle of Badr through its various aspects. The book provides an analysis of the motives for the invasion and its details, including its preparation, the course of the battle, and the type of fighting, along with the results and backgrounds that resulted from it. The book shows how the Battle of Badr was characterized by direct guidance from revelation and practical application by Muslims, emphasizing the importance of studying the Prophet’s biography as a method and guide for learning and imitation.
descriptions.2282: In this book, Sheikh Muhammad bin Abdul Wahhab presents many benefits extracted from the story of the Treaty of Hudaybiyyah, as he addresses many aspects of it from a religious and spiritual perspective, reviewing through dozens of benefits how this historical event can be a school for Islamic teachings in piety, working with the heart, and diligence in religion. The book focuses on explaining the effects and lessons of reconciliation, and how it can serve as an example for Muslims in their spiritual and practical lives.
descriptions.2283: This is the book “The Joy of Forums and the Pursuit of Examples” by the author Al-Amiri Al-Haradhi, and it is classified under the classification of biography and virtues. The book is a summary of the miracles, biographies, and virtues of the Prophet, and includes Qur’anic verses, Prophetic hadiths, jurisprudential issues, and legal and linguistic literature. The book aims to facilitate the understanding and interpretation of these miracles and miracles, and to present them in the form of an easy and accessible summary. The book is considered an important source for learning about the biography of the Prophet Muhammad ﷺ and his virtues, and it is considered one of the most important books in this field.
descriptions.2284: The book The Messenger’s Signs ﷺ and His Miracles by the writer Abdul Majeed Al-Zindani falls within the classification of biography and virtues, and reviews the evidence for the prophecy of Muhammad, peace and blessings be upon him, through what he calls the glad tidings and his scientific miracles in the Qur’an and Sunnah. It consists of five chapters, including a chapter focusing on glad tidings, an introduction to the qualities of the Prophet and the components of his faith, and another chapter that shows the scientific miracle of the verses with reference to the linguistic meanings and interpretations of commentators. The author aims to convince the reader that there is evidence from texts and sciences that support the position of the Messenger, peace and blessings be upon him.
descriptions.2285: Tarikh al-Khamis fi Ahwal Anfas al-Nafis or Tarikh Khamis or Tarikh al-Khamis is a historical encyclopedia on the history of Islam written by the Sunni Islamic scholar Hussein bin Muhammad al-Diyarbakri (who died in 1559 AD (966 AH). It was published in Cairo in 1884 AD (1302 AH) and was reprinted in Beirut in 1390 AH. Diyarbakri is considered one of the most famous late historians.
descriptions.2286: The book Confirming Evidence of Prophethood by Qai Abdul Jabbar is concerned with presenting arguments from the Qur’an and Sunnah that show the connection of prophecy between God and man. In its parts, it reviews multiple topics, including the declaring of nations to be infidels, the Messenger’s positions with the polytheists, and miracles that were revealed in Mecca. It also covers details about the Companions and their management of the affairs after the death of the Prophet, relying on Qur’anic texts and prophetic sayings to demonstrate the validity of the prophecy. The book falls within the classification of biography and virtues, and is considered a reference that strengthens the doctrinal understanding of prophecy in Islam.
descriptions.2287: The book “The Burdah Trilogy, The Burdah of the Messenger ﷺ” by Dr. Hassan Hussein deals with a literary study of three important poetic poems in Islamic literature, which are the Burdah of Ka’b ibn Zuhair, the Burdah of Imam al-Busayri, and Nahj al-Burda by Ahmed Shawqi. The book focuses on analyzing these poems from an artistic and literary perspective, with an emphasis on praising and glorifying the Messenger ﷺ, and includes an explanation and interpretation of the three poems, along with a review of their main themes and various poetic purposes.
descriptions.2288: Gathering of Means in Sharh Al-Shama’il by Mullah Ali Al-Qari is a book that specializes in the biography of the Prophet, peace and blessings be upon him, and his characteristics. It sheds light on his character, the seal of prophethood, his hair, his clothes, and other details of his life. The book covers multiple chapters that address every aspect of his appearance, habits, daily tools, and the characteristics of his sword and armor, based on hadith evidence. It aims to compile and clarify what was stated in the Prophet’s Companions to provide a comprehensive reference for researchers and those interested in his prophetic biography.
descriptions.2289: The book “The Efforts of Muslim Scholars in Distinguishing Authentic Biography” by the writer Abdul Karim bin Zaid Akwi is concerned with studying the methodology of scholars in distinguishing between authentic and weak hadiths within the Prophet’s biography, based on the rules of examining news and criticizing narrations established by hadith scholars. In his chapters, the author presents topics such as knowing the truth and weakness, discovering the lies of narrators, and arranging news sources according to their strength, with a focus on taking into account the circumstances of the news and recalling evidence and circumstances. The book concludes with an overview of the general rules of customs and Sunnah, and to benefit researchers by reviewing sources and references related to this field.
descriptions.2290: Jami’ al-Birah al-Nabawiyyah: It is a brief book on the biography of the Prophet, compiled by Imam Ibn Hazm. His goal behind its classification was to provide a brief, accessible, accessible, in the hands of his students, as he did in many of his historical treatises, such as the treatise “Nukt al-Arous” and his treatises on men of readings, hadiths, conquests, and histories of the caliphs. In this summary, he included the principles that every student of knowledge who studies the Prophet’s biography cannot do without remembering or memorizing. The book deals with the common life of the Prophet ﷺ from his birth to his death, highlighting his virtues, qualities, and fragrant morals.
descriptions.2291: This is the book “Jami’ al-Sira and Five Other Treatises” by the scholar Ibn Hazm, and it is a book from the classification of Sirah and Shama’il. The book contains a table of contents that includes many chapters and chapters that deal with various aspects of the life of the Prophet ﷺ, from his birth and resurrection to his conquests, princes, and morals. The book begins with Ibn Hazm defining himself and the biography of the Prophet, then moving on to address multiple topics, including the lineage of the Messenger ﷺ, his birth and resurrection, the importance of the Prophet’s biography in the doctrine of the people of Zahir, and multiplying the Sunnahs and benefiting from them. It appears from the excerpt at the beginning of the book that Ibn Hazm aimed to put the Prophet’s biography in a concise, accessible form in the hands of his students, but this was not the only goal of his writing the biography.
descriptions.2292: This book, “Gardens of Lights and Views of Secrets in the Biography of the Chosen Prophet,” is a work in the field of the Prophet’s biography and the virtues of Muhammad. It deals with the life of the Prophet Muhammad ﷺ, his lineage, and important events from his biography. The author begins by mentioning the virtues of Mecca and Medina, then moves on to the lineage of the Prophet and his ancestors, and mentions some important historical facts, such as the digging of the Zamzam Well and the incident of the elephant companions. The book includes an introduction by the author and indexes to its content, while providing a glimpse into the life of its author, Burning the Yemeni, and his other writings.
descriptions.2293: This is a book on biography and merits, dealing with the rights of the Prophet ﷺ over his nation as stated in the light of the Qur’an and Sunnah. The author focuses on explaining the necessity of believing in the Prophet, obeying him, and following his Sunnah, detailing this in sections that include the meaning of believing in him, the generality of his message, the seal of prophecy, his infallibility, and the necessity of obeying him. The book aims to clarify this great principle of the origins of religion and clarify it according to what the nation’s righteous predecessors were.
descriptions.2294: The book “The Life of Muhammad ﷺ” by Muhammad Hussein Haykal is a work on the Prophet’s biography. It deals with the life of the Prophet Muhammad from a perspective in which the author criticizes some Orientalist and missionary approaches, and seeks to present the biography by relying on the Qur’an as a primary source. The book includes discussions about the relationship of Islam with Christianity, the Orientalists’ position on the Prophet, and issues of Islamic renewal and intellectual stagnation, with a focus on criticizing some contemporary writings that have been influenced by Orientalist studies.
descriptions.2295: This book deals with the life of the Prophet Muhammad ﷺ and his message, but it presents the point of view of the Qadianis, which is considered a sect contrary to Sunni Shiite Islam. The author Muhammad Ali Lahori Al-Qadiani focuses on spreading his Qadiani ideas through his interpretation of the Qur’an and the biography of the Prophet, trying to integrate his own beliefs with the biography of the Prophet. The book presents a different vision of traditional Islam, as it denies some basic Islamic obligations such as jihad, and offers unconventional interpretations of Qur’anic verses and hadiths of the Prophet.
descriptions.2296: The book “The Seal of the Prophets” by Muhammad Abu Zahra falls within the biography of the Prophet Muhammad and an explanation of his virtues, as it begins with a glorifying introduction to the Prophet and an explanation of his status as the Seal of the Prophets, then moves to an intellectual and religious discussion that includes Indian sects such as Zoroastrianism, Manichaeism, Mazdakism, and Brahmanism, in addition to a study of social classes in Indian society and Buddhism. The author aims to show the uniqueness of the Islamic message compared to these beliefs, based on a detailed review of the characteristics and beliefs.
descriptions.2297: This is a brief book on the Prophet’s biography, compiled by its author from twelve books, and containing twenty-four chapters. The book begins by mentioning the lineage of the Prophet ﷺ and his birth, then it deals with a summary of his conquests, circumstances, Hajj, and lifespan, and is concerned with his moral and ethical qualities and miracles, and concludes by mentioning his wives, children, uncles, aunts, servants, tools, and his death.
descriptions.2298: This book is an academic study in the biography of the Prophet Muhammad ﷺ. It aims to present the basic structure of the biography’s events in an equal manner, and to analyze them from an objective, scientific perspective that avoids imaginative or materialistic extremism. The author relies on primary sources in Islamic biography and history, and reviews important events from the birth of the Prophet to the migration and Islamic expansion, with a focus on the political, military, personal, jurisprudential, and spiritual aspects of the biography.
descriptions.2299: Evidence of the Prophet is one of the biography books, written by Abu Naim Al-Asbahani (336 AH - 430 AH).
descriptions.2300: The book “Evidence of Prophethood and Knowledge of the Conditions of the Owner of Sharia” by Imam Abu Bakr Al-Bayhaqi is an encyclopedic work in the section on biography and virtues, collecting evidence and proofs of the prophethood of the Prophet Muhammad ﷺ. The book begins with an introduction that addresses the methods of proving prophecy from the Qur’an and elsewhere, then moves on to narrate the evidence of prophecy through the stories of the early companions’ conversion to Islam, such as Khadija, Abu Bakr, and Abu Dhar, leading to the characteristics of the Islamic conception and the jihad of the Prophet ﷺ. The book received praise from ancient and modern scholars, as Al-Hafiz Ibn Katheer described it as one of the best works written on biography and poetry.
descriptions.2301: Evidence of Prophethood and Knowledge of the Conditions of the Author of Sharia Law, known for short as Evidence of Prophethood, is a book by Abu Bakr Ahmad bin Al-Hussein Al-Bayhaqi. It is among the most important and comprehensive biography books, as it presents the narratives with their chains of transmission to the owners of respected books, and sometimes he talks about the narratives and explains their condition.
descriptions.2302: The book “Al-Uqabi’s Relics in the Virtues of Kin” is a book on biography and virtues, and is considered one of the most important works of the author Muhib al-Din al-Tabari. The book is concerned with the virtues of the Prophet’s household, and includes chapters mentioning kinship, mentioning the recommendation of the Prophet ﷺ to the family of Quraysh, mentioning verses revealed about them, mentioning the encouragement to love them, mentioning their selection, mentioning that they are the best of people, mentioning that they are the best of Quraysh, and mentioning that they are the masters of the people of Paradise. The book is an important source for learning about the merits and ranks of the Prophet’s family.
descriptions.2303: This book, “The Paths of Guidance and Righteousness in the Biography of the Best of Servants,” is a book on the biography of the Prophet and the virtues of Muhammad. It deals with the life of the Prophet Muhammad ﷺ, starting from his honorable lineage until his departure to the highest heaven. The author relies on multiple sources and seeks accuracy in conveying facts and events, presenting a comprehensive and integrated picture of the Prophet’s biography, conditions, and actions. The book aims to provide a good example for people to follow the Sunnah of the Prophet and obey him, based on the narration, study and criticism of Sunnah and Hadith books.
descriptions.2304: This is the book “The Gloomy Solace of the Death of the Beloved ﷺ” by the author Ibn Nasir al-Din al-Dimashqi. It is classified under the classification of biography and merits. This book is considered one of the most important historical sources that dealt with the life of the Prophet Muhammad ﷺ, especially with regard to his death and its effects on the Companions.
descriptions.2305: The Biography of Ibn Ishaq is a book that combines biography, virtues, and the conquests of the Prophet. It is presented by Muhammad ibn Ishaq through the narration of Yunus ibn Bukayr. It deals with various topics such as the excavation of Zamzam, the marriage of Abdullah ibn Abdul Muttalib, the birth of the Messenger, stories of the elephant, and Salman the Persian’s conversion to Islam, in addition to hadiths about the Kaaba and graves. The text combines historical narrative and social analysis of Arabia in the pre-unity period, highlighting the economic and cultural interactions between Mecca and the north of the peninsula. The book also highlights the influence of neighboring civilizations on Mecca by mentioning the Persians, Byzantines, Jews, and Christians. The text remains a reference for researchers into the biography of the Prophet and the events of the early invasions.
descriptions.2306: This is the book “Explanation of Al-Zarqani on the Ladani Talents with Muhammadiyah Grants” by the author Muhammad bin Abdul Baqi Al-Zarqani, and it falls within the classification of biography and virtues. The book contains a table of contents that covers various topics related to the Prophet’s biography, including the translation of the author Shihab al-Din Ahmad bin Muhammad al-Qastalani, an explanation of the introduction to al-Mawahib al-Ludaniyya, an explanation of al-Maqasid, and an explanation of the events of the Prophet’s biography, such as the Year of the Elephant and the story of Abraha, the marriage of the Prophet ﷺ to Khadija, the construction of the Kaaba by Quraysh, the mission of the Prophet ﷺ, the levels of revelation, and the conversion of Hamzah. This book is considered one of the important sources in understanding the Prophet’s biography and the Prophet’s virtues.
descriptions.2307: Explanation of Al-Shifa by Mullah Ali Al-Qari is a medium-length explanation of the original book “Al-Shifa bi Definition of the Rights of the Chosen One” by Judge Ayyad, and it falls within the classification of Sirah wal-Shama’il. It aims to clarify and detail the praise and glorification of God Almighty and then show the qualities of the Prophet Muhammad, from the perfection of majesty to the virtues of lineage and moral character. The explanation covers multiple chapters that address praise of God, the attributes of the Prophet, and a comparison between acquired and innate virtues, based on Qur’anic verses and Prophetic hadiths.
descriptions.2308: The book Sharaf Al-Mustafa by Al-Khabrukhi falls within the biography of the Prophet and his virtues, and aims to provide a comprehensive study of the text and its written sources and document its chain of transmission. It includes a religious introductory introduction, then chapters dealing with the author’s translation, his writings, his importance, a description of the written versions, and the biographies of the aforementioned narrators. The author highlights his keenness to show the virtues of the Prophet ﷺ by analyzing the texts and clarifying their chains of transmission.
descriptions.2309: The book “The Companions of the Messenger ﷺ” by Sheikh Ahmed bin Abdel Fattah Zawawi falls within the biography of the Prophet and his virtues. It reviews Quranic verses related to prophecy and the message and then deals with God’s comfort for the Prophet, his compassion, his orders, and his recommendation in various aspects from sincerity to honesty and good character. His book includes multiple introductions and a detailed research methodology, relying on collecting what is authentic from the hadiths in the two Sahihs or one of them, in an effort to provide educational benefits from the biography of Khair al-Bariyya. It aims to enhance the reader’s love and glorification of the Prophet by showcasing his qualities and miracles.
descriptions.2310: The book presents “Martyrs of one of those mentioned by Ibn Ishaq in his battles” by the writer Muhammad bin Abdullah Ghaban Al-Subhi, who is the author of a biography and Shamail. It opens with a religious introduction that includes the glorification of God and Quranic references, then deals with the Battle of Uhud and the virtue of its martyrs. The content is divided into chapters that list the names of the companions who were martyred in the battle according to their affiliation with the Muhajireen, Aws, and Khazraj, with each name mentioned separately.
descriptions.2311: Uyun al-Athar is a work on the biography of the Prophet. It was compiled by al-Hafiz Fath al-Din Muhammad bin Muhammad Ibn Sayyid al-Nas al-Yamari al-Andalusi, and it is one of his most important and famous works. It was accepted and praised by scholars after him. Among those who praised it was Imam Taj al-Din al-Subki (d. 771 AH) when he said, “Sheikh Fath al-Din wrote a book on battles and biographies called Uyun al-Athar, and he did well in it as he wished.” Ibn Katheer (d. 771 AH) described it as good as he wanted. 774 AH) by saying: “He collected a good biography in two volumes,” and Imam Al-Hafiz Ibn Hajar (d. 852 AH) described him by saying: “He compiled his book called Uyun al-Athar on the biography, which is a good book in its field.” Imam Al-Shawkani (d. 1250 AH) said about him, “He has collections, including the famous biography of the Prophet, which people from the people of the era benefited from...
descriptions.2312: The book “Ghayat al-Soul fi Characteristics of the Messenger” by Sheikh Ibn al-Mulqin falls within the classification of biography and virtues, and is concerned with detailing the characteristics of the Prophet ﷺ, with a focus on the rulings related to marriage, including what is forbidden, what is permissible, and what is lenient. The author includes chapters on obligations and permissible matters, in addition to sections dealing with the karamah of matters other than marriage and a comparison between what is forbidden and what is permissible.
