The author presents a comprehensive study on the movement of present tense letters, examining it from various aspects, such as their distinctive signs, structure, and grammatical analysis. The author shows his interest in the single word, and presents its division into a noun, a verb, and a letter, while addressing it in terms of its type, structure, and meaning. The author points out that the present tense is a section of the verb, and one of its types, with which grammarians, morphologists, and linguists have preoccupied, and he provides a detailed study on the signs of the present tense, its parsing, and its movement.
descriptions.3056: Letters of Meanings and Attributes was one of the first books that dealt with the phenomenon of letters from its grammatical and linguistic aspects. It is a mini dictionary of about one hundred and fifty linguistic tools. Al-Zajjaji is distinguished by his special way of dealing with linguistic and grammatical phenomena. He frequently quotes ancient Arabic poetry and Qur’anic verses, and his style is characterized by encyclopedism and depth. The subject of the book is someone who asked him to write a book in which he explains all the meanings of the letters, and in how many ways the letter behaves.
descriptions.3057: This book, “Al-Khattab Al-Maridi and His Methodology in Grammar,” by the author Hassan Musa Al-Shaer, is considered a scientific book in the field of grammar and morphology, in which he studies and analyzes Al-Khattab Al-Maridi’s approach to grammar. In this book, the author shows details about the life of Al-Khattab Al-Maridi and his social and political environment in Andalusia, where he lived in the fifth century AH and witnessed the fall of the Umayyad Caliphate in Andalusia. The author also shows how his approach to grammar was distinct and reflected the influence of the social and political environment in which he lived.
descriptions.3058: This book, “A Student’s Guide to the Grammarian’s Words,” by Marai Al-Karmi, is classified under the category of grammar and morphology. This book is considered one of the main sources in the science of Arabic grammar, as it covers the basics of grammar and morphology, including the word and speech, the noun, the verb, and the letter, parsing and construction, the inflected and the constructed, grammatical signs, the rulings on the present tense, the indefinite and the acquaintance, the rulings on nouns, the subject, the subject, the subject, the subject, the predicate, the connective to the rule of the subject and the predicate, the subordinate, the accusative, the object, the absolute object, and the object for its sake. And the object in it, and the object with it, and the adverb, and distinction, and the exception, and the noun “no,” and the caller, and the genitives, and the worker, and words that agree with different meanings, and sentences, and calligraphy. This book is an important source for learning and studying Arabic grammar.
descriptions.3059: This book, “Risala Al-Hudud” by the author Abu Al-Hasan Al-Rummani, is classified under the category of grammar and morphology. The book covers multiple topics in grammar, including analogy, proof, statement, judgment, cause, denotation, noun, verb, letter, parsing, construction, change, conjugation, purpose, cause, knowledge, indefinite article, singular, sentence, dual, plural, nominative, accusative, dative, subjunctive, adjective, substitution, pattern, distinction, addition, infinitive, derivation, appearance, implicit, interest, agent, deletion, male, compound, restricted, exception, truth, metaphor, gender, type, and force. Weakness, lightening, licentiousness, shortened, extended, masculine, feminine, counterpart, antithesis, appreciative, investigation, origin, branch, constant, rare, predicate, interrogative, part, answer, straight, critical, incidental, necessary, necessary, meaning, pronunciation, speech, accident, exponent, inflectional, metaphor, truth, matter, rank, appropriate, special, rich, needy, great, contemptible, and incident.
descriptions.3060: The Message of the Angels is a book written by Abu Al-Ala Al-Maarri, which is classified under the category of grammar and morphology. The book contains a small treatise entitled “The Message of the Angels,” written by Abu Al-Ala Al-Ma’arri as appendices in his book “Abu Al-Ala and the like.” The message consists of answers to morphological questions, as Abu Al-Ala answered questions given to him by Abu Al-Qasim Ali bin Muhammad bin Hammam. The book contains 16 issues, and Abu Al-Ala discusses in these issues the origins of 21 linguistic subjects. This book is considered one of the rarest letters of Abu Al-Ala that have come down to us, and it was published after it was found in the Al-Dhahiria Library in Damascus.
descriptions.3061: This is a grammatical message by Imam Ahmed bin Qasim Al-Abadi, which deals with the issue of the active participle when it is intended to continue in all tenses, and discusses the ruling on adding it to knowledge, and whether it is useful in defining it or not. It also discusses the difference between the active participle that indicates confirmation and the doubtful adjective, and the extent to which each of them works, through a question sent to the author and his answer.
descriptions.3062: This book, “Risala Manazil Al-Haruf” by the author Abu Al-Hasan Al-Rummani, is considered within the category of grammar and morphology. The book provides a table of contents that includes topics related to the Arabic letters, such as the letters’ houses, llamas, alifs, ha’s, ya’s, nunas, ta’s, faces of ma’s, and letters’ houses. The book begins with a discussion of letter lamas, where the author introduces the different types of lamas, such as the lam of the beginning, the lam of division, the lam of addition, the lam of definition, and the lam of addition. The book goes on to discuss other letters, such as the alifs, ha's, ya's, nuns, and ta's. The book shows interest in linguistic analysis and definition of the types of Arabic letters.
descriptions.3063: This is a part in which Al-Hafiz Jalal al-Din al-Suyuti collected the narrated reports on the reason for establishing the Arabic flag, and it is classified in the section on grammar and morphology. The author begins with an introduction in which he states his purpose in collecting these reports, then he cites connected narratives with his chain of transmission that tell the story of the arrival of a Bedouin in the time of Omar ibn al-Khattab (may Allah be pleased with him) and his incorrect reading that led to a different understanding of the meaning, which was the reason for the order to establish the rules of grammar at the hands of Abu Al-Aswad Al-Du’ali.
descriptions.3064: Shadha Al-Arf fi the Art of Morphology is a book on morphology, written by Sheikh Ahmed bin Muhammad Al-Hamalawi Al-Azhari Al-Daraami (1856-1932 AD), and it is one of the books that received great acclaim among the people of eloquence and rhetoric. The imam, linguist and writer Sheikh Tantawi Johari said about it in the year 1894 AD: The book contains three chapters: The first chapter: On the verb. Chapter Two: Speaking about the name. Chapter Three: On rulings that include the name.
descriptions.3065: Sharh Ibn Aqeel is a book on grammar and morphology written by Chief Justice Bahaa al-Din Abdullah bin Aqeel al-Hamdani al-Masri. It is an explanation of Ibn Malik's Alfiyyah in various sections of grammar and morphology, with a detailed parsing of the evidence. The book was published in several editions by multiple publishing houses.
descriptions.3066: Al-Salik's approach to Alfiyyah Ibn Malik, known as “Sharh Al-Ashmouni,” is a book on grammar and morphology, written by the grammarian and fundamentalist jurist Abu Al-Hasan Al-Ashmouni. The book is an explanation of Ibn Malik's Alfiyyah in various sections of grammar and morphology. The book was published in several editions by multiple publishing houses.
descriptions.3067: This book, “Sharh al-Baṭāḥ ala al-Taḥrīh or al-Iṭāṭah bi-Maṭūn” by Sheikh Khaled al-Azhari, is considered one of the most important explanations of grammar and morphology in the Islamic heritage. The book contains an extensive table of contents covering various branches of grammar and morphology, including speech and what it consists of, the introduction, the chapter explaining the inflected and the intransitive, the indefinite section and knowledge, the knowledge section, the demonstrative nouns section, the relative section, the article definite article, the subject and predicate section, the subject verbs and predicate section, the subject verbs and predicates after completing their subject. This book is considered one of the most important sources for understanding grammar and morphology in the Arabic language, and it is considered one of the most important explanations made by Arabic scholars in ancient times.
descriptions.3068: The book “Sharh Al-Kafiyah Al-Shafiyah” by Ibn Malik is considered an encyclopedic work in the field of grammar and morphology. In its various volumes, the book deals with basic sections in grammar, such as speech and what it consists of, parsing and construction, indefinite nouns and nominatives, beginning, verbs and letters that are accusative and nominative, in addition to a detailed explanation of the nouns and verbs. In his explanation, the author adheres to a clear methodology aimed at facilitating grammatical issues and bringing them closer to the reader.
descriptions.3069: This book is a study and investigation of the explanation of “Shafiya Ibn al-Hajib” by the linguist and grammarian Rukn al-Din al-Astarabadi. The book covers the author's biography and scientific life, in addition to the era in which he lived from political, economic, social, cultural and religious aspects. The book also includes an extensive study of Al-Astarabadi’s efforts in the field of grammar and morphology, with an investigation of one of his most important books.
descriptions.3070: The book Explanation of Shadhur al-Dhahab fi Ma’rifat al-Speech of the Arabs is a grammar book written by Ibn Hisham al-Ansari. It is an explanation of the expressions formulated by the author Ibn Hisham himself in his book called: Shadhur al-Dhahab. It includes all the grammar chapters in a manner close to his book Qatar al-Nada and Bel al-Sada. The book was printed several times, and among the most famous were the copies that were printed edited by Muhammad Muhyi al-Din Abd al-Hamid.
descriptions.3071: Explanation of Qatar al-Nada and Bel al-Sada is a book on grammar, authored by: Ibn Hisham al-Ansari. It is an explanation of the terms coined by the author Ibn Hisham himself in his brief book called: Qatar al-Nada, and it includes most of the grammar chapters in a manner close to his book: Shadhur al-Dhahab fi Ma’rifat al-Speech of the Arabs. The book was printed several times, and among the most famous were the copies that were printed and edited by: Muhammad Muhyi al-Din Abd al-Hamid.
descriptions.3072: This book includes two explanations of “Marah al-Souh” on morphology, one by Dickinson and the other by Ibn Kamal Pasha. The two explanations begin with an introduction to the importance of morphology, then discuss in detail the various sections of morphology, starting with the construction of the correct verb, passing through the double, the marginal, and the conjugated, and ending with the declension, with an explanation of morphological examples such as the past, present, imperative, and nouns of the subject, object, time, place, and instrument.
descriptions.3073: This book is a commentary on Ibn Malik's Alfiyyah on Grammar. The work provides a comprehensive explanation of the text, clarifying its meanings and parsing. It also deals with a historical overview of the emergence and development of the science of grammar, and points out the differences between the main grammatical schools of thought such as the Basri and Kufic schools of thought. It also contains an explanation of various examples and evidence, with the addition of important morphological topics that were not mentioned in the original sources, with the aim of clarifying the grammatical and morphological rules more clearly and in depth.
descriptions.3074: This book, “The Phenomenon of Borrowing in Arabic Grammar,” by Ahmed Muhammad Abdullah, is considered a book specialized in grammar and morphology, as it deals with the phenomenon of borrowing in the Arabic language. The book begins with an introduction that explains the concept of analogy and its placement in the context of Arabic grammar. Then it moves on to an analysis of the various types of analogy, such as the analogy between two words in form and form, and the third type: the analogy between two words in meanings. The book shows that borrowing is correct in what it does, provided that it has support from listening and correct guidance, which confirms that our Arabic language is flexible and malleable. The book is a useful resource for researchers in the field of grammar and morphology, and contributes to understanding the phenomenon of borrowing in the Arabic language.
descriptions.3075: This is a book on Arabic grammar that studies the phenomenon of “tqasa”, which is a linguistic method in which two words exchange a grammatical or morphological ruling between them, such as each taking a ruling from the other and taking a similar ruling from it. The author presents the concept of this phenomenon linguistically and idiomatically, then discusses its applications in three main areas: its implementation among grammatical titles, replacing some letters with others, and adding some letters.
descriptions.3076: The book “Aqoud al-Hamza” by Ibn Jinni is a work on grammar and morphology that deals with the study of the conditions of the hamza in the Arabic word according to its location and the letters before and after it. The author focuses on the different cases in which the hamza can appear and the rules for writing and pronouncing it in each case, relying on examples to explain his rules.
descriptions.3077: This is a book on grammar and morphology by Abu al-Fath Uthman ibn Jinni, devoted to studying the “reasons of duality” in the Arabic language. The author examines the nature of the Alif of the Deuteronomy and its Nun, and presents the various opinions of grammarians regarding it, such as the opinion of Sibawayh, Al-Akhfash, and Al-Farra’, then he prefers the opinion that he deems stronger based on evidence and objections. The book also deals with related topics such as the duality of the ambiguous and the conditions of the dual and plural nouns, which makes it a specialized study in the rulings of the dual and its morphological and grammatical reasons.
descriptions.3078: The book “The Reasons for Grammar” by Ibn al-Warraq is one of the fundamental works in the science of grammar, in which the author deals with the interpretation of the parts of speech and the principles of their construction, with a focus on the analysis of letters, verbs, and nouns and their functions in the Arabic sentence. The book aims to explain the rationale behind grammar rules and how to apply them, while providing explanations of some complex linguistic rules.
descriptions.3079: This is a book on grammar and morphology, written by Abu Jaafar al-Nahhas. It is concerned with the craft of writing, its etiquette, and the derivation of its tools, beginning with a talk about the basmalah, the letters of the dictionary, the days of the week, and the months. The author then moves to the second part of the book, explaining by explaining the derivation of the names of the books of God Almighty, mentioning writing instruments such as the pen and inkwell, and explaining the rulings on dictation, emphasizing that the craft of writing is a branch of religion and does not contradict the rulings of Sharia.
descriptions.3080: This book, “Fath Al-Mu’talali on the Poem Called Balamiya Al-Af’al,” by the author Hamad bin Muhammad Al-Saidi, is considered a book in the field of grammar and morphology. The book contains a table of contents that shows its topics, which include studying the book, explanations of the Lamite verbs, their discussions, explanations of the Lamite verbs, a comparison between this book and the nazim’s explanation, opening the locks, and a description of the written versions. It seems that the author has revised the book and explained some grammatical and morphological terms. The excerpt from the beginning of the book shows that the author has researched his lineage and environment, although no precise information about his life has been found. This book is a useful resource for grammar and morphology specialists, especially those seeking studies on the lemming of verbs.
descriptions.3081: The Book of Numbers in the Language by Ibn Sayyidah deals with the subject of numbers in the Arabic language from the perspective of grammar and morphology, focusing on the interpretation of the terms number, counting, and arithmetic, and explaining their meanings and examples of their use in poetry and the Qur’an. The author focuses on analyzing nouns and verbs related to numbers and how they are used in statistics and estimation, while providing examples from linguistic sources and the Holy Qur’an.
descriptions.3082: Al-Ajrumiyah by Ibn Ajrum is a book on grammar and morphology that deals in detail with the rules of parsing and its divisions, with an explanation of its signs and controls. The book begins by defining the types of speech and their classification, then moves on to clarifying the concept of parsing and its four sections, and explains in detail the nominative, accusative, and lowering signs, mentioning the positions of each sign and its application cases.
descriptions.3083: This is the book “Matn Qatar al-Nada wa Bel al-Sada” by Sheikh Jamal al-Din Ibn Hisham. It is a book on grammar and morphology that is considered one of the most important sources in this field. The book provides a definition of the word and its parts, then goes on to explain the principles of grammar such as the subject, the predicate, the subject, the substitute for the subject, the function, the conflict, the accusative object, the adverb, dependencies, number, contraindications for noun morphology, the exclamatory, and the pause in the most eloquent. The book shows clear detail in explaining the principles of grammar and morphology, making it a valuable resource for study and benefit.
descriptions.3084: This book is a summary of the entire book “Mughni al-Labib from the Books of Arabs” by Ibn Hisham al-Ansari, prepared and presented by Sheikh Muhammad bin Saleh al-Uthaymeen. The book deals with the topics of grammar and morphology through the interpretation of vocabulary, sentences, adverbial rulings, the genitive case, and the genitive case, and aims to provide a useful reference for students of science in the field of grammar science and the Arabic language.
descriptions.3085: This is a grammatical book specialized in studying the article “then” from its various aspects, such as its origin, function, conditions for its operation, meaning, and grammatical and written provisions. It falls within the approach that singles out one tool of meanings for independent study, thus following a grammatical path known to some scholars.
descriptions.3086: The book “Controversial Issues in Grammar” by Al-Akbari Abu Al-Baqa deals with controversial and controversial issues in the science of grammar, focusing on definitions of basic grammar terms and points of disagreement among linguists in their interpretation and analysis. The book addresses topics such as the issue of speech and sentences, the limits of nouns and verbs, derivation, parsing, and morphology, relying on a discussion of different points of view on them and an analysis of the grammatical evidence provided for each point of view.
descriptions.3087: Mughni al-Labib, on the books of Arabs, is a (linguistic) work in the field of grammar. One of the most prominent contributions of Ibn Hisham al-Ansari, the Egyptian great grammarian who died (761 AH). It is a unique work of its kind, rich in its material and unparalleled. This book serves as a link between all his works, and he took a distinctive approach in it, collecting tools and letters classified according to the letters of the dictionary, collecting their fragments, and separating their rules, then going over the general rulings. For sentences and the like, and the divisions and branches that follow, and an explanation of the general rules of grammar and the errors that the parsers make. In addition to all of this, it is abundant in its Qur’anic and poetic evidence. It also includes within it the opinions of many grammarians and scholars who preceded Ibn Hisham...
descriptions.3088: This book, “Malhat Al-Israb” by Al-Hariri, is considered one of the most important books in the field of grammar and morphology. The book provides a definition of speech and an explanation of various aspects of grammar, such as defining the noun, the verb, and the letter, explaining the different types of the verb, explaining the indefinite nouns, explaining the object nouns, explaining transitive verbs, and other topics. The book is an important source for learning and benefiting in the field of grammar and morphology.
descriptions.3089: A book that deals with the history of Arabic grammar since its inception, tracing the stages of its development and its first motives, such as melody. The book studies the two main grammatical schools: Basri and Kufic, and analyzes the nature of the disagreement between them and its impact on issues of hearing and analogy, with applied examples of grammarian disagreements. It also deals with later schools of thought, such as the Baghdadi school of thought and the Andalusian school, and concludes with chapters on the most prominent grammatical works, such as the book of Sibawayh and the works of Ibn Jinni, Al-Zamakhshari, and Ibn Malik.
descriptions.3090: This book, written by Imam Ibn Malik, deals with the topic of derivation in the Arabic language. It includes an introduction and preface that explain the importance and benefits of derivation, then details its definition and types, discusses disagreements about it among scholars, reviews the principles and rules that must be taken into account in the derivation process, and provides examples of the changes that may occur between the original word and the word derived from it. The book aims to provide an integrated and detailed study on the issue of derivation in the Arabic language.
descriptions.3091: This book, “Conducting Students to the Grammar of Parsing,” by author Khaled Al-Azhari, is considered a book in the field of grammar and morphology. It aims to explain the grammar of parsing and put them on the basis of clear principles. The book contains a table of contents that shows its organization and structure, as it is divided into chapters related to understanding sentences and sentences that have a place in grammatical analysis, as well as the genitive case and the genitive case in it, and the interpretation of many words that the grammaticalizer needs. The book begins with a greeting to God and His Messenger Muhammad, then moves on to explaining the rules of parsing, presenting excerpts from the beginning of the book, which show the author’s way of explaining the rules and placing them on the basis of clear principles. This book is a useful resource for teachers and students in the field of grammar and morphology.
descriptions.3092: The book “The Results of Thought in Grammar” by Al-Suhaili deals with the science of grammar and morphology, addressing in its discussions various grammatical and lexical issues, including addition, verbal connotation, grammatical signs, and the conjugation of nouns and verbs. In his discussions, the author cites Qur’anic verses to derive grammatical rules, explaining the wisdom of Qur’anic expression and its linguistic connotations.
descriptions.3093: The book “Naq’at al-Sidyān fi ṭafālān” by Al-Saghānī is a linguistic and morphological dictionary that specializes in collecting and studying Arabic words that have the form of “fā’lān.” The author aims to serve students of hadith and hadith, as he explains the sources and morphological structures of these words, citing Quranic verses and Arabic poetry, and indicating the aspects of linguistic usage and the irregularities in them.
descriptions.3094: This is a book on grammar and morphology, in which the author explains his book “Collecting Al-Jawaami’,” which he collected from about a hundred works in Arabic. The explanation aims to resolve the premises of the book, clarify its meanings, and explain its rulings. The author has committed himself to brevity and conciseness, while being aware of grammatical issues and disagreements therein. The book begins with introductions to the definition of the word, its parts, parsing, and construction, and then addresses grammatical topics in succession, such as nominatives, accusatives, and genitives.
descriptions.3095: This book deals with the provisions of fasting in the month of Ramadan by answering forty-eight questions about various aspects of this worship. The questions address various topics related to the prohibitions and obligations associated with fasting, and answers them in a systematic, scientific manner, reviewing important jurisprudential rulings related to fasting and praying during the month of Ramadan. The book is directed to help Muslims better understand the provisions of fasting and implement them correctly.
descriptions.3096: A book that sheds light on the common mistakes that some pilgrims make while performing Hajj rituals, basing their explanation on the guidance of the Prophet ﷺ. The book is organized into chapters that detail mistakes in Ihram, Tawaf, standing at Arafat, throwing stones at Jamarat, and the Farewell Tawaf, dividing mistakes in Tawaf into two parts, actual and verbal. Through this, the author aims to alert pilgrims and correct their path so that their Hajj is in accordance with Sharia.
descriptions.3097: This is an introductory summary of the book “Guidance of the Worshipful Concerning the Ruling on Staying in Janubah, Menstruating Women, and Postpartum Childbirth” by the author Sherif Murad: This book is one of the important sources in understanding the rulings on impurity, menstruation, and postpartum in Islam, as it focuses on the ruling on the impurity, menstruation, and postpartum women staying in mosques. The author begins by defining impurity, menstruation, and postpartum, then moves on to present the scholars’ statements on this issue, including the statements of the jurists and the scholars’ fatwas. The book aims to guide the worshiper in understanding the provisions of this issue and determining what is permissible and forbidden for the impure woman, menstruating woman, or postpartum woman to remain in mosques.
descriptions.3098: This research collects the Prophetic hadiths that were mentioned related to the end of the prayers, and studies them in a hadith study, while clarifying the meaning of “the end of the prayer” and its inclusion of what comes before and after the salutation. The research aims to distinguish the authentic hadiths from the weak ones in this section, while clarifying the difference between what relates to supplication before the salutation and what relates to the remembrances after it.
descriptions.3099: This book is a study of the Islamic economic system. It deals with the definition of the economy and the types of economic systems, with a focus on the concept of the economic system in Islam and the role of the state in it. The book reviews the departments of authorities and areas of state economic intervention, whether direct or indirect, within the framework of a fundamental study based on the Islamic jurisprudential and financial heritage.
descriptions.3100: This book, “Commentary on the Message of the Truth of Fasting and the Book of Fasting,” was written by Sheikh Muhammad bin Saleh al-Uthaymeen. It is considered a book in the field of Islamic jurisprudence. It contains comments on the message of “The Truth of Fasting” by Sheikh al-Islam Taqi al-Din Ibn Taymiyyah, and the book “Fasting” from the Branches by the scholar Shams al-Din Muhammad bin Mufleh. The book covers topics related to fasting, such as breaking the fast, kohl and injection, Ramadan fasting, making up for the fast, and winding it up, and also deals with other issues related to fasting. This book is a useful resource for Muslims who want to understand the provisions of fasting and do it correctly.
descriptions.3101: This book, “Al-Jami` li-Ahkam al-Salaat,” by Mahmoud Abdel-Latif Awaida, is a jurisprudential book that focuses on the rulings on prayer in Islam. The book contains a comprehensive table of contents covering various aspects of prayer, including rulings on purity, specific impurities, shed blood, and wine. The book seems to aim to provide a comprehensive and clear overview of the rulings on prayer in Islam, with clear guidance based on Islamic texts.
descriptions.3102: This book, “The Complete Rulings on Fasting,” is a comprehensive jurisprudential research that addresses the rulings on fasting in Islam from a contemporary jurisprudential perspective. The author, Mahmoud Abdel-Latif Aweida, focuses on reviewing the Qur’anic texts and Prophetic Sunnahs related to fasting, relying on authentic and good hadiths only, and reviewing the opinions of jurists on disputed issues. The book addresses multiple topics about fasting the month of Ramadan, its provisions, its virtues, conditions for fasting, and cases of breaking the fast, while presenting a jurisprudential model that aims to clarify the legal rulings in a systematic and comprehensive manner.
descriptions.3103: This book deals with the topic of crime and punishment in Islam, and explains the starting point of Sharia in confronting crime and the principles on which the Islamic penal system is based, such as non-criminalization before the introduction of Sharia, pardoning what came before, and avoiding punishment based on suspicions. It also reviews the advantages of this system, such as the integration between internal motives and external control, and addressing the social causes and motives for crime such as murder, theft, adultery, and drinking alcohol, while explaining Islamic solutions to them.
descriptions.3104: This book, “Disagreement: Its Causes and Etiquette,” by the author Ayed Al-Qarni, is considered one of the books of Islamic thought that is concerned with studying the causes of disagreement and the etiquette that must be followed in dealing with it. The book begins by defining disagreement and explaining its importance in the universe, then moves on to studying its causes, where it defines error as the main gateway to disagreement, and reviews other causes that may lead to disagreement, such as envy, hatred, and fanaticism. After that, the book introduces the etiquette of disagreement, such as sincerity, follow-up, wishing the dissenter to return to the right path, listening to argument and opinion, presenting evidence, being calm in responding, and mentioning aspects of agreement before disagreeing. The book aims to provide tools for dealing with disagreement in a correct manner, and enhancing the spirit of cooperation and consensus in society.
descriptions.3105: This book deals with jurisprudential and Sharia research on the ruling on a woman looking at a man without desire, expressing its danger to the woman and its negative impact on her psyche and spirit. The author focuses on warning of the consequences of glaring, considering that looking is a dangerous arrow for men and women alike, even though its impact increases on women. The book is divided into chapters that address different dimensions of this topic, basing its arguments on legal texts and Qur’anic and Prophetic evidence.
descriptions.3106: This book, “Criticism and Statement in Repulsing the Illusions of Khuzayran,” written by Muhammad Kamel al-Qassab, is considered an edited scientific research on heresy and some of its vocabulary. It provides a comprehensive introduction to the Salafists and the issue of Palestine, and the ruling on self-adventurous operations. It contains the sayings of the Hanafi, Shafi’i, Maliki, and Hanbali masters about the subject of the message and their support for it, in addition to a copy of the fatwa of Sheikh Abdullah al-Jazzar. The book aims to dispel Khuziran's illusions and provide a scientific outlook on these issues.
descriptions.3107: A book that collects research on contemporary jurisprudential issues, written by a scholar, and covers emerging issues in worship such as the use of wastewater and zakat on shares, in financial transactions such as banknotes and vacancy allowances, in felonies such as car accidents, in judiciary such as ruling based on evidence, and in medicine such as brain death, organ transplantation, and artificial insemination. The book aims to explain the legal rulings on these developments based on jurisprudential rules and analogy, taking into account the simplicity of Sharia and its validity for all times and places.
descriptions.3108: This book, “The Credit Card,” by Bakr Abu Zaid, is an extensive study in the field of Islamic economics and financial jurisprudence. The book sheds light on the concept of the credit card, its history, types, parties, benefits, harms, and its ruling from a Sharia perspective. The book aims to explain the truth about the credit card, which in reality is considered a usurious loan with immediate and deferred interest, and to explain the prohibition of dealing with it from the perspective of Islam. The book is considered a useful resource for specialists in Islamic economics and financial jurisprudence, as well as for those interested in trade and economics.
descriptions.3109: This book deals with multiple topics related to the blessed month of Ramadan, as it focuses on the virtues of the holy month and the importance of taking advantage of its numbered days in worship and providing for goodness. The book includes lessons on fasting, repentance, righteousness, health, calling to God, and good morals. It also discusses the benefits of i'tikaf, Laylat al-Qadr, and the importance of suhoor. The author aims to remind the reader of the importance of saving time and using it for good deeds during this blessed month, while warning of the harms of excessive entertainment and staying up late.
descriptions.3110: This book is a scientific treatise that aims to dispel the illusion that there is a contradiction between the hadiths of jurisprudential rulings, with a focus on the Book of Purity. It begins with a fundamental introduction about the meaning of contradiction and preponderance and their causes, then reviews previous writings in this field, after which it studies and analyzes a number of controversial jurisprudential issues such as the impurity of water, ablution thanks to a woman, the secretion of a dog and cat, and semen, combining the various hadiths in them and compiling them.
descriptions.3111: This book, “Refuting the Illusion of Conflicting Hadiths on Rulings in the Book of Purity” by author Ruqayyah Al-Muharrib, is classified under automatically numbered research and issues. The book aims to collect hadiths related to purity and analyze them from a scientific perspective, with the aim of reconciling the different hadiths and determining the objectives of Sharia law. The book covers multiple topics such as the meaning of conflict and its causes, the meaning of weighting and its causes, and previous literature on this topic. The book is considered one of the most important sources in hadith and jurisprudence, and is considered a useful source for researchers and students in this field.
descriptions.3112: This book is an explanation of the message “Important Lessons for the Common Nation” by its author, Sheikh Abdul Aziz bin Baz, explained and detailed by Sheikh Abdul Karim Al-Khudair. The book deals with various topics of faith and worship, such as the pillars of faith, monotheism, the pillars of Islam, prayer, and their conditions and duties, in addition to their Sunnahs and invalidations, and aims to simplify these concepts for common Muslims. The book is numbered automatically, and is divided into sequential lessons, each lesson dealing with a specific topic of Islamic beliefs and worship.
descriptions.3113: This is the book “Explanation of the Rituals of Sheikh al-Islam Ibn Taymiyyah” by the author Abdul Karim al-Khudair. This book is a summary of issues related to Hajj, in which Sheikh al-Islam Ibn Taymiyyah (deceased: 728 AH) explains the rituals of Hajj, and presents some issues on which he differs with others. The book is very brief, containing sixty pages, and deals with some of the issues that pilgrims need most of the time. This book is an explanation of some of the issues on which the Sheikh of Islam disagrees with others, and it deals with some rulings and comments on the rituals of Hajj.
descriptions.3114: This book provides an explanation and detail of the method of prayer of the Prophet Muhammad ﷺ, indicating its pillars, etiquette, actions, and words. The author focuses on the importance of a heart-to-body orientation in prayer, and quotes prophetic hadiths related to prayer to confirm the validity of the aforementioned practices. The book is divided into chapters that address each part of the prayer, from the takbir to the tashahhud, with an emphasis on the spiritual and devotional importance of the prayer.
descriptions.3115: This is a brief message on the rain prayer, which explains the concept of rain prayer, its ruling, the causes of drought and withholding rain, the types of rain rain, its etiquette, how to pray for rain, the location of the rain prayer sermon, prophetic supplications proven in rain rain, and rain etiquette. The author, Saeed bin Wahf Al-Qahtani, explains these issues in the light of the Qur’an and Sunnah, mentioning verses from the signs of God Almighty, and explaining that seeking rain from the stars and nights is a matter of pre-Islamic times.
descriptions.3116: This book deals with the provisions of the Eid prayer and the eclipse prayer, explaining their evidence from the Qur’an and Sunnah, and reviewing their provisions, conditions, and etiquette. It also mentions the difference between the Eid al-Fitr prayer and the Eid al-Adha prayer, and explains the ruling on women attending the Eid and the rulings on the eclipse prayer. It emphasizes the illegality of creating new holidays outside of what Islam has prescribed, such as Eid al-Fitr and Eid al-Adha.
descriptions.3117: This book, “Chapters on Fasting, Tarawih, and Zakat” by the author Ibn Uthaymeen, is considered an automatically numbered book in the classification of research and issues. It contains chapters related to fasting, Tarawih, and zakat. The book covers the ruling on fasting and its benefits, things that invalidate fasting, Tarawih, zakat and its benefits, those who are entitled to zakat, and zakat al-Fitr. The book begins with a discussion of the ruling on fasting and its benefits, then deals with the ruling on fasting for the sick and the traveler, things that invalidate fasting, Tarawih prayers, zakat and its benefits, the recipients of zakat, and zakat al-Fitr. The book shows the author's interest in Islamic and jurisprudential affairs, and seeks to provide useful information to Muslims on these topics.
descriptions.3118: The book “Family Jurisprudence” by the scholar Muhammad al-Mukhtar al-Shanqeeti deals with the provisions and rights of the family in Islamic law, explaining the duties of the husband towards his wife, his family, and his relatives, and their rights over him, while emphasizing the necessity of justice and fairness in dealing between family members, and explaining what each individual must do toward the other. The book also reviews the provisions and conditions of marriage, the rights of surrogates and the necessity of their connection, while discussing some contemporary issues related to family and marriage.
descriptions.3119: The book “Jurisprudence of Worship” by Sheikh Muhammad bin Saleh Al-Uthaymeen is a collection of questions and answers on matters of belief and worship. It begins with fatwas on monotheism, faith and its pillars, and addresses topics such as the purpose of creating human beings, the types of monotheism, the ruling on magic, divination and astrology, and the characteristics of the saved sect. The book falls within the jurisprudential and doctrinal classification, and relies on the question-and-answer method in presenting issues.
descriptions.3120: This book deals with the jurisprudence of calamities related to matters of worship, focusing on the provisions of purity and prayer. It begins by defining the concept of calamities and explaining their importance in Islamic jurisprudence, then studies a series of emerging jurisprudential issues in the field of purity, such as the uses of chemical drugs and modern technologies in cleaning and purifying the body. He then moves on to the issues of prayer, reviewing contemporary issues related to its performance and conditions in the modern era. The book was prepared by Dr. Khaled Al-Mushayqih, and it consists of automatically numbered scientific lectures within a jurisprudence course held at Al-Rajhi Mosque in Buraidah.
descriptions.3121: The amount of money in the pride of the Arabs is one of the books that talked about the virtues of the Arabs and what was mentioned about them in the Prophetic hadiths and hadiths, written by Ibn Hajar Al-Haytami.
descriptions.3122: This book by Muhammad bin Saleh Al-Uthaymeen deals with the provisions of the sacrifice and zakat on Eid Al-Adha, summarizing the basic jurisprudential rules related to this Islamic ritual. The first nine chapters deal with the conditions and provisions of the sacrifice, the best one, the one for whom it is sufficient, its appointment, and the rulings on zakat. The last two chapters focus on the etiquette and disadvantages of zakat. The book is a summary of a previous book by the author, aiming to provide the necessary information without detailing the jurisprudential disputes.
descriptions.3123: This is a summary of the rituals of Sheikh al-Islam Ibn Taymiyyah. It is a book that deals with the subject of Hajj and rituals, and aims to facilitate understanding and applying the provisions of Hajj to the people of our time. The book is considered one of the important sources in the field of Islamic jurisprudence, as it combines a correct understanding of legal texts and benefiting from the experiences of the righteous predecessors. The book contains sequential chapters that address various aspects of Hajj, from introducing the Hajj, its ruling, and ability to perform it, to the intention to enter ihram, how to recite the Talbiyah, the mustahabs of ihram, and the prohibitions of ihram. The author shows a keenness to facilitate benefit and compatibility with the circumstances of the people of the era, which makes the book a useful resource for those who wish to understand and apply the provisions of Hajj.
descriptions.3124: This is an introductory summary of the book “Women’s Issues,” written by Dr. Ruqayyah Al-Muharib: This book is considered one of the most important sources that dealt with women’s issues in Islamic jurisprudence. It deals with topics such as the ruling on yellowness and turbidity during menstruation and at other times, the ruling on dampness during days other than menstruation, doubt about purity, and how a woman can differentiate between menstruation and istihaadah and get rid of obsessive thoughts. The book is considered an important resource for Muslim women that helps them understand and apply the provisions of Sharia law in their daily lives.
descriptions.3125: This book deals with the rulings on praying for rain and the rulings on funerals. It explains the definition and legitimacy of praying for rain, and studies the ruling on praying for rain, its description and rulings. It also mentions the factors for its acceptance. As for the chapter on the rulings on funerals, it details the rulings on the sick and the dying, and on death, washing, shrouding, praying over the dead, and burying him, and discusses the rulings on condolence and visiting graves.
descriptions.3126: This book, “60 Questions and Answers on the Rulings of Menstruation,” by the author Ibn Uthaymeen, is considered a jurisprudential book that focuses on the rulings on menstruation in acts of worship, such as prayer, fasting, purity, Hajj, and Umrah. The book combines common questions and answers that clarify the rulings on menstruation in various fields. The book aims to provide clear answers and assistance to Muslim women in understanding and applying the provisions of menstruation in their daily lives.
descriptions.3127: This book researched the hadiths reported about the Prophet ﷺ’s reading in the noon, afternoon, and Friday prayers. The author divided it into sections that dealt with the authentic, good, and weak hadiths, with their grading and judgment according to the rules of hadith scholars. It also included various indexes to facilitate benefiting from its content, and it provided translations of some narrators and scholars’ sayings regarding the rulings on hadiths.
descriptions.3128: This is a research concerned with studying the hadiths related to reading in the dawn prayer, collecting them and extracting them from the books of the Sunnah. The research includes three sections: the hadiths on reading in the dawn prayer, the hadiths on reading in the dawn prayer on Friday, and the hadiths on reading in prayer not restricted to dawn or anything else. This research is considered one of the modest studies in the field of Prophetic Hadith. It aims to collect and graduate hadiths related to the subject, analyze them, and determine their correct degree.
descriptions.3129: This book deals with the rulings on people of religion and apostasy from the perspective of Islamic jurisprudence, focusing on the issues of Imam Ahmad ibn Hanbal in this field. The book addresses multiple topics related to the status of the people of the Dhimmah, polytheists, and heretics in Islamic society, with a focus on the issue of whether Jews and Christians are considered part of the nation of Muhammad ﷺ or not. The book also addresses issues related to the conversion of children to Islam and their rulings, and cases of religious conversion between Muslims and others, while presenting the opinions of Imam Ahmed bin Hanbal on these topics.
descriptions.3130: This is the book “Personal Status Provisions in Islamic Sharia” by the author Abdul-Wahhab Khallaf. This book is considered one of the most important sources in the field of personal status in Islam, as it combines the doctrine of Imam Abu Hanifa with what is currently being done in Egyptian Sharia courts from other schools of thought. The book covers multiple topics such as marriage, guardianship over marriage, agency in marriage, taboos for women, rulings on marriage, divorce, and other topics. This book is an important source for jurists, lawyers, and researchers in the field of personal status in Islam.
descriptions.3131: This book deals with the provisions of the sacrifice and zakat in Islam, and explains the definition of the sacrifice and its ruling, the conditions for what is sacrificed, its times, and the disliked customs therein, with details of the etiquette of the sacrifice and its dislikes. The author divided the topic into ten chapters to facilitate understanding of the jurisprudential provisions related to sacrifice and zakat.
descriptions.3132: This is a treatise that deals with the subject of the difference in the sighting of the crescent of Dhu al-Hijjah, and it was written by the imam, the Hafiz, the jurist, Abu al-Faraj Abd al-Rahman bin Rajab al-Hanbali. The author deals with an important issue in Islamic jurisprudence, which is the difference in the sighting of the crescent of Dhul-Hijjah, and provides an accurate and detailed analysis of the various aspects of this issue. The author demonstrates his skills in investigation and study, and presents a researched text that demonstrates high quality typography and formatting.
descriptions.3133: This book deals with the rulings on Ithbaa’ and sand during Tawaf, which are among the recommended Sunnahs in the rituals of Hajj and Umrah. The author focuses on the definition of these two acts, the evidence of their legitimacy, their ruling, their timing, and the cases of their legitimacy. It also clarifies the connection between impression and sand in legal rulings and controls. The book is a type of specialized jurisprudential research, directed to those who wish to study the jurisprudential details of Islamic rituals.
descriptions.3134: This book, “Rules of Prayer” by the author Sheikh Muhammad bin Abdul Wahhab, is considered part of his works, and covers an important topic in Islam, which is the rules of prayer. The book provides a comprehensive overview of the conditions of prayer, its pillars, what invalidates it, its duties, the obligations of ablution, the conditions for ablution, and what nullifies ablution. The book shows the author's interest in delving deeper into the rulings on prayer, and providing detailed information about its conditions, pillars, and duties. This book is a valuable resource for Muslims who wish to better understand the provisions of prayer.
descriptions.3135: This book, “The Rulings of the Two Eids in the Purified Sunnah” by the scholar Ali bin Hassan Al-Halabi, deals with the rulings of the two Eids from a legal perspective based on the hadiths of the Prophet ﷺ. The author focuses on clarifying the obligations, desirables, and disliked matters related to the two Eids, such as wearing clothes, saying takbir, prayer, sermon, and other jurisprudential details. The book aims to educate Muslims about the correct rulings of Eid in accordance with the purified Sunnah of the Prophet.
descriptions.3136: This book, “Rulings for Making up the Day of Fasting,” by Awad Al-Omari, is part of the “Research and Issues” category. The book covers topics related to making up for fasting, including making up for someone who forgets and relying on a time ejaculate without intercourse, making up for intercourse due to forgetfulness or intentionally, making up for those with excuses, making up for the dead, and voluntary fasting. The book begins with a definition of the topic and an explanation of the Qur’anic verses related to fasting, then moves to the chapters related to making up for fasting. The book demonstrates an interest in Islamic governance and jurisprudence, and constitutes a useful resource for specialists in this field.
descriptions.3137: This book deals with the rulings on touching in Islamic law related to purity, and reviews the jurisprudential issues related to touching the private parts and the resulting effects on the validity of worship. The author, Abdullah Al-Sahli, focuses on detailing the jurisprudential rulings related to touching the vulva and other private parts, relying on Sharia evidence to explain the ruling on each case. The book is a type of jurisprudential research that aims to clarify controversial issues in Islamic jurisprudence and bring the truth closer to them.
descriptions.3138: This book deals with the provisions of jihad with one's life for the sake of God from the perspective of Islamic jurisprudence, addressing the definition of jihad and its types, the legitimacy of jihad with one's life and the stages of its legislation, the virtue of the mujahideen and the goals of jihad, with a focus on the conditions of the mujahid and the ruling on jihad against him. The book also studies the rulings of the Mujahid in acts of worship, especially in the field of purity and prayer, while providing details on the issues of tayammum and wiping over the socks in cases of Jihad.
descriptions.3139: This book, “The Rulings of Mosques in Islamic Sharia, Part Two,” by Ibrahim Al-Khudairi, is part of a series of research and issues. The book deals with the topic of mosque architecture in Islamic law, and deals with various aspects of building mosques, such as their location, their construction over or towards graves, their construction in general, their parts, ownership, and analysis. The book begins by discussing the idea that the entire earth is a mosque, and expands on the rulings on mosques, separating it into different chapters and topics. The book aims to provide a deep understanding of the issues of building mosques in Islamic law, and to analyze various aspects of these issues.
descriptions.3140: This book, “Rules of Wishing for Death,” written by Sheikh Al-Islam Muhammad bin Abdul-Wahhab, is considered part of his works. The book is concerned with studying the rulings on wishing for death through a group of Prophetic hadiths that dealt with this topic. The book shows the author's interest in the interpretation and analysis of prophetic influences in this field, and seeks to clarify the rules and regulations that must be followed when wishing for death. The book is considered an important source for study and research in the field of Islamic jurisprudence and prophetic monuments.
descriptions.3141: This book deals with the rulings on the patient’s prayer and purification, and reviews fatwas related to the various conditions of patients and cases of exception in prayer and ablution. It focuses on Sharia guidelines related to patients in hospitals and how they should perform religious rituals under the special circumstances they are experiencing, while providing answers to specific questions related to various medical situations.
descriptions.3142: The book “Rulings for Disobedient Believers” by author Marwan Kajak deals with research and issues in Islamic jurisprudence, focusing on the rulings for those who disobey Sharia law and deviate from its approach. The author focuses on clarifying the issues of atonement and disbelief, and discusses the issue of the possibility of declaring a Muslim to be atone for the sin of his actions, relying on the texts of Sharia and the rules of jurisprudence. He calls for the necessity of following the approach of the righteous predecessors and staying away from contemporary ideas that may lead to negligence or excessive application of Sharia rulings.
descriptions.3143: This book, “Rules for Prayer at Night,” by Suleiman Alwan, is part of the “Research and Issues” category. The book covers topics related to the night prayer, including the time of prayer, the number of rak’ahs, how to pray, recitation of Witr prayer, and Qunoot. The book begins by mentioning the virtue of the night prayer and explaining the purposes of Sharia, then it moves on to address issues related to the night prayer, such as the time of prayer, the number of rak’ahs, how to pray, recitation of Witr prayer, and qunoot. The book shows an interest in correct jurisprudence, returning to evidence and understanding the objectives of Sharia.
descriptions.3144: This book, “Conditions of the Dying One,” by the author Muhammad Abdel Aziz Ahmed Al-Ali, is classified under the category of “Research and Issues.” This book is considered one of the most important books that dealt with the subject of dying and death from an Islamic perspective, as it examines the conditions of the dying person and studies what happens to him upon his death. It deals with various topics related to the subject, such as death throes, the presence of angels, the cessation of repentance, the return to this world, the presence of Satan, and indoctrinating the dying person that there is no god but God. This book is considered an important source for learning about the doctrine of the Sunnis and the community regarding the subject, and it helps to understand the importance of knowing the conditions of the dying person in terms of inner and outer well-being.
descriptions.3145: Performing what is required of explaining the status of the two positions in Rajab is a book about the innovation of the month of Rajab, written by Al-Hafiz Ibn Dahiya Al-Kalbi (544 AH - 633 AH). The author explained in his book the virtues mentioned in the month of Rajab, and that all of them are not proven, and he mentioned the innovations that people have introduced in this holy month, such as the prayer of desires, and singling it out for fasting, or Umrah, and other acts of worship, and he mentioned the talk about the Night Journey and Mi’raj and that it was not proven. It is true that this incident occurred in the month of Rajab.
descriptions.3146: The book “Husbands by Lying” by Abdullah Al-Ruhaili is considered a social study concerned with addressing a social problem that affects members of society, and seeks to raise people’s awareness of this serious issue. The book shows how some individuals approach marriage with faulty logic, preferring to care about the wife's career over her personal and religious value. The book presents a comprehensive approach to the problem, by describing and analyzing it, and then offers suggested solutions to prevent or treat it, while including real stories and diverse opinions on the topic. The book aims to educate society and motivate individuals to return to the right path in their marital dealings.
descriptions.3147: This is a book on the science of form, compiled by Al-Suyuti from traces and reports, and it discusses the creation of the heavens and the earth, the throne, the chair, the tablet, and the pen, and what was mentioned in the hadiths and narrations. The book aims to provide a description of the major cosmic creatures based on what is transmitted from the texts, to serve as an example to those with insight.
descriptions.3148: This book, “The Best Stores and Explaining the Rulings of One Who Defeats His Homeland,” by the author Al-Wansharisi, is classified under the “Research and Issues” category. The book is surrounded by jurisprudential concepts on issues related to Muslims residing in countries dominated by Christians. It also deals with the ruling on the blood and property of a resident of the land of war, the speeches of the judges of the people of the Garden, the appointment of judges, and other topics. The excerpt from the beginning of the book shows that the book deals with topics related to migration to the land of Islam, the regret of some Christians over their migration, censure of the land of Islam and its affairs, and other topics related to religion and jurisprudence.
descriptions.3149: The book deals with the importance of praying for rain in Islam and the legitimate call for help, explaining the wisdom of this devotional ritual and its importance in asking for rain from God Almighty. The author reviews a hadith by Omar ibn al-Khattab (may Allah be pleased with him) about praying for rain with Al-Abbas, and also discusses seeking supplication with the lives of the dead and the living, considering it unlawful. The book is of the type of research and religious issues, and aims to clarify Islamic jurisprudence about prayer for rain and seeking help, with a focus on its importance and legal controls.
descriptions.3150: This book, “Ithaf al-Ahbab, as proven regarding the issue of the hijab,” by the author Abdul Qadir bin Habib Allah al-Sindi, is considered a book in the field of Islamic jurisprudence. It deals with the subject of the hijab and the Muslim woman in the Qur’an and the Sunnah, and presents an answer to a question related to the hijab of the Muslim woman in light of the Qur’an, the Sunnah, and the consensus of the nation. The book shows an interest in teaching Muslim women their great role in corrupting the world if they step out of their place, and the necessity of their righteousness for the good of human society. This book is considered one of the important sources in understanding the issue of hijab in Islam.
descriptions.3151: The book “Ithaf Dhu’l-Marwah wal-Anafah with What is Concerned about Charity” by Sheikh Ibn Hajar Al-Haytami deals with research and issues on the virtues of charity and hospitality and their rulings. The author focuses on encouraging spending and explaining the virtue of charity, citing evidence from the Qur’an and Sunnah. The book also deals with the ruling on zakat and its controls, and calls for subservience and sacrifice for the sake of God, showing the virtue of those who provide good hospitality and respond to the call of need. The book aims to remind the rich of the provisions of zakat and the necessity of helping the poor and needy, especially in times of disasters and drought.
descriptions.3152: This book, “The Answer to the Question on Zakat on Money,” by the author Muhammad bin Abdul Aziz Al-Sudais, is considered one of the important books in the jurisprudence of zakat, as it focuses on explaining the provisions of zakat and the conditions that must be met to achieve it. The book addresses topics such as the wisdom behind the legality of zakat, the circumstances of those who prevent zakat, the conditions that must be met to achieve zakat, and the different classifications of zakat. The book begins by defining zakat in language and Sharia, then addresses the wisdom behind the legality of zakat, before moving on to explain the conditions that must be met to achieve zakat, such as Islam, obligation, freedom, one year, quorum, complete ownership, and intention. This book is an important resource for Muslims who wish to understand the provisions of zakat and its related actions.
descriptions.3153: The book presents time management from Islamic and administrative perspectives, as author Khaled Al-Jarisi addresses the importance of time in Islam through the Qur’an and Sunnah, and compares this to modern administrative theories. It also presents effective time management strategies from an Islamic perspective, and studies applied cases to enhance practical understanding of the subject.
descriptions.3154: This book deals with the provisions for performing the prayer in congregation and the Friday prayer, reviewing the views of jurists on how to perform the rak’ah, prayer in congregation, and the Friday prayer. The author focuses on discussing the sayings of the four schools of thought and their implications, with the aim of arriving at a correct understanding of the provisions of collective prayer and its virtue, while highlighting the importance of attending it and skipping its obligatory prayers.
descriptions.3155: Repairing mosques from heresies and customs is a book that includes heresies that occur in mosques and caution against them, written by Jamal al-Din al-Qasimi (1283 - 1332 AH = 1866 - 1914 AD).
descriptions.3156: This book is a study on the topic of the imam of the mosque, aiming to explain the scientific and moral characteristics that the imam should possess. The author reviews the position of the mosque in Islam, then moves on to talk about the imam and his attributes, dividing them into scientific and moral components, and concludes the research with a conclusion and recommendations.
descriptions.3157: This book, “The Difference between the Two Lands and its Effects on the Rulings of Islamic Sharia,” by the author Abdul Aziz bin Mabrouk Al-Ahmadi, is considered an encyclopedic study in Islamic jurisprudence, dealing with the subject of the division between the land of Islam and the land of disbelief, and its effects on the legal rulings. The book begins by defining the two houses and defining the meaning of both. Then it deals with the inhabitants of Dar al-Islam, talks about Dar al-Kufr and its divisions, and addresses the change in the description of the Dar, and the effects of the division on the differences in rulings. This book is an important resource for jurists and commentators, and contributes to understanding and applying the provisions of Islamic law in various contexts.
descriptions.3158: The book “Muslims’ Welcome to Ramadan” by Sheikh Attiya Salem covers research on the importance of the month of Ramadan and the provisions of fasting, reviewing the etiquette of fasting and the importance of preparing to welcome this holy month. The author focuses on the virtue of Ramadan and the worship and obedience that it entails, showing how the righteous predecessors received this month and prepared for it, and how they prayed to God to reach Ramadan and grant them success in it.
descriptions.3159: This book, “Etiquette and Rulings Related to Entering the Bathroom,” by Ibn Kathir, is part of the “Research and Issues” category. The book contains one chapter, and deals with topics related to entering the bathroom, including hadiths of the Prophet and etiquette related to this topic. The book begins by mentioning the story of Suleiman bin Daoud, then moves on to mention the Prophetic hadiths related to entering the bathroom, and also discusses the opinions of scholars on this issue. The book is considered one of the important sources in understanding the etiquette and rulings related to entering the bathroom in Islam.
descriptions.3160: This book deals with the Prophetic hadiths prohibiting the sale of certain things and commercial practices prohibited in Islamic law. The author, Suleiman bin Saleh Al-Thunayan, focuses on the content of hadiths related to forbidden items for sale, commercial transactions tainted by deception and doubt, and illegal terms in contracts. The book aims to explain the legal rulings related to buying and selling and warn Muslims against forbidden transactions.
descriptions.3161: The book “The Comprehensive Rulings on the Important Lessons for the Common Ummah” is an explanation of the treatise “The Important Lessons for the Common Ummah” by Sheikh Abdul Aziz bin Baz, aiming to clarify the legal sciences it contains. The book is organized into eighteen lessons covering the pillars of Islam and faith, the provisions of prayer and ablution, Islamic ethics, warning against polytheism and sin, and preparing the dead. It has been classified under Research and Issues, and is directed to general Muslims to be an easy aid and reference in understanding belief, worship, and behavior.
descriptions.3162: This book, “Evidence and Proofs of the Prohibition of Smoking,” by Sheikh Ibrahim Muhammad Sarsik, aims to clarify the prohibition of smoking from a legal perspective, based on explicit texts in Islam that indicate the danger of smoking to health and money. The book highlights the harm caused by smoking, such as wasting health, exposing the body to death from lung cancer, and numbing the body with nicotine. The book also examines why smoking is so common among young people, and provides advice on how to stop smoking. This book is a useful resource for Muslims seeking a better understanding of Islam's approach to health and well-being.
descriptions.3163: This book by Ibn Qutaybah Al-Dinawari deals with the topic of drinks and the differences that arise around them among people, and reviews the arguments of those who are forbidden and those who are forbidden regarding the issue of intoxicating drinks. The book also shows the error of some groups on this subject by exaggeration, and calls for a fair statement regarding drinking.
descriptions.3164: The book “Al-Ashraba” by Imam Ahmad ibn Hanbal is a collection of prophetic hadiths and hadiths concerned with clarifying the rulings on drinking in Islam. It focuses in particular on the prohibition of every intoxicant, whether small or large, and specifying the types of wine and the circumstances in which it is forbidden to abstain from it, with details of the rulings related to alcohol, gambling, and everything that goes wrong.
descriptions.3165: This book deals with the topic of drugs and intoxicants from a legal and health perspective, as it focuses on the different types of drugs and their harm to the individual and society. The author divides his study into three chapters. The first begins by defining the types of drugs and moves on to analyzing the harms of each of them, while the second chapter focuses on alcohol and its negative effects. The third chapter reviews the general harms of drug use at various levels. The book is part of efforts to combat the spread of drugs in Muslim societies and warn people of their dangers.
descriptions.3166: This is a book explaining the truth about the holidays in Islam and its position on the holidays of non-Muslims. It begins by reviewing the holidays of the Jews, Christians, Magians, and Arabs in pre-Islamic times and their customs therein. Then it moves on to explaining the legitimacy of disobeying the infidels and the evidence for the prohibition of imitating them in their holidays. It concludes by defining the legal holidays in time and place in Islam and explaining the good qualities they contain that enrich Muslims over others.
descriptions.3167: This book, “The Wish to Realize Intentions,” by the poet and philosopher Al-Qarafi, is considered one of his most important and famous books. The book is concerned with discussing the issue of intention and divine and human actions, and deals with issues such as understanding intention, actions that can be done for God Almighty and for others, what actions can only be done for God Almighty, and what cannot be done for God Almighty. The book contains multiple chapters that address these issues, and is characterized by detail and analysis. This book is considered one of the most important sources in understanding Islamic thought and Arab philosophy, and is considered an important source for researchers in this field.
descriptions.3168: This book deals with Islamic economic research that focuses on the concept of equitable distribution of wealth between individuals and countries. The author, Muhammad Shawqi Al-Fangari, addresses the issue of economic balance from an Islamic perspective, reviewing the realistic and moral controls guaranteed by Islam to ensure that every individual obtains his share of livelihood to ensure a decent life. The book also analyzes various economic systems such as capitalism, socialism, and Islamic systems, discusses the concept of the “limit of sufficiency” in Islamic jurisprudence, and sheds light on the principles of Islamic economics in distributing wealth and achieving social justice.
descriptions.3169: This is a jurisprudential book that examines the rulings on disposing of an orphan’s money, and explains what is permissible for the guardian and others to benefit from this money in compensation contracts such as buying, selling, speculation, and mortgage, and in donation contracts such as lending, lending, gift, charity, and endowment, with an explanation of the principle in the guardian’s actions and their legal controls.
descriptions.3170: The book “Disclosing the Hadiths on Marriage” by Ibn Hajar Al-Haytami is a study on issues related to the hadiths on marriage. The book deals with hadiths related to the virtues, benefits, and rulings of marriage, with an explanation of who produced these hadiths. The book begins with an introduction to the importance of marriage and the virtues of marriage, then reviews a group of hadiths related to the topic.
descriptions.3171: This is a book that examines the issue of atheism and injustice in the Sacred Mosque, and their relationship with will and implementation, through a study of the noble verse {And whoever inclines therein to atheism with injustice - We will make him taste a painful punishment}. The book is organized into two chapters, the first deals with the boundaries and differences between the Sanctuary and the Grand Mosque, while the second details the meanings of will, atheism, and injustice, mentioning some of the characteristics of the honest country. Its writing emerged from a conversation that raised a question about the danger of simply wanting to commit sin in this particular place.
descriptions.3172: This book is a legal study specializing in the rulings on mourning, which is abstaining from adornment, perfume, and the like for a woman whose husband has died. It begins by defining mourning linguistically and legally, then moves on to explaining its legal ruling and the evidence for its obligation. It reviews the conditions that must be met by a woman observing the waiting period, such as reason, puberty, and Islam, while discussing precise jurisprudential issues such as the requirement of death or the validity of the marriage. The book also divides mourning into its legitimate and prohibited categories in Islam, to serve as a brief reference on this important jurisprudential issue.
descriptions.3173: Al-Injad fi Chapters on Jihad is a book on the jurisprudence of jihad written by Abu Abdullah Muhammad bin Isa bin Muhammad bin Asbagh bin Al-Manasif Al-Azdi Al-Qurtubi (d. about 620 AH), one of the Maliki jurists in Andalusia. The book is considered one of the first to discuss the rulings on jihad in Maliki jurisprudence.
descriptions.3174: This book, “Fairness in the Truth of the Saints and Their Kinds and Kindnesses,” written by Muhammad bin Ismail al-San’ani, is considered an important book in the “Research and Issues” classification. It deals with the subject of the saints’ kindnesses and kindnesses, and attempts to strike a balance between exaggeration and harshness regarding them. The book begins by defining karamat and kindness, and deals with people’s categories in this regard. Then it moves on to clarifying the principles of the Sunnis and the community on this subject, and presents the textual evidence and narrations that indicate confirmation of karamat for saints. The book aims to clarify the facts and principles in this field, and is considered an important source for learning and studying this subject.
descriptions.3175: The book “Fairness among Muslim Scholars in Reciting” by Abu Omar Ibn Abd al-Barr al-Maliki is a comparative jurisprudential study that deals with the issue of reciting the Basmalah in prayer. The author aims to clarify the position of the Salaf scholars regarding the Companions and Followers regarding whether it is revealed openly or hidden, and whether it is considered a verse from Al-Fatihah or not. The book presents the opinions of the imams of jurists in different countries, and reviews the effects and evidence on which each group based its choice, seeking to achieve justice between these opinions.
descriptions.3176: This is the book “The Followers” ​​by the author Ibn Abi Al-Izz, and it is classified under the category “Research and Issues.” The book shows interest in warning of division and following one's desires, and the author believes that division in religion is a dangerous matter that threatens the unity of Islamic society. The book is based on the Qur’anic verses that urge us to cling to the rope of God and not become separated, and the author refers to the sayings of the Prophet ﷺ and the fathers of Muslims in this regard. The book is considered an important source for understanding Ibn Abi al-Izz’s thought and his interest in Islamic traditions.
descriptions.3177: This book examines the issue of curriculum planning from an Islamic perspective, emphasizing the necessity of drawing inspiration from the Islamic educational heritage rather than relying on foreign educational thought. The book reviews the concept of educational planning and its various fields, starting from planning field education to planning the daily lesson, with a focus on the foundations of Islamic education and its characteristics. The author aims to present an integrated vision for developing school curricula in a way that achieves Islamic identity and keeps pace with contemporary scientific progress.
descriptions.3178: This is a book on the jurisprudence of the tax and its rulings. It examines its legal meaning and its origin in Islam, and an explanation of the first caliphs to impose it, the lands on which the tax is placed and which it is not, its amount, the ruling on the disposal of the owners of the tax land therein, and its legal disbursements. The book is organized into multiple sections that address these issues based on what was stated in the Sunnah of the Prophet and the sayings of the Companions, with special attention to Omar bin Al-Khattab (may Allah be pleased with him)’s status of the tax.
descriptions.3179: This book, “Intentional Participation in the Crime of Murder,” by author Abdullah Al-Sahli, falls under the category of “Research and Issues.” The book covers topics related to crime against oneself, including the definition of the crime, its types, unlawful killing, the legality of retaliation against oneself and without oneself, intentional participation in the crime against one by killing, and intentional participation in the crime against one by wounding or cutting. The book begins with a discussion of man's creation and dignity, God's responsibility to protect him, and the prohibition of killing him unjustly. The book shows an interest in studying the Islamic faith and Sharia law regarding self-destruction.
descriptions.3180: This book, “Scientific Research, Its Theoretical Fundamentals and Practical Practice,” by Raja Wahid Doueidari, is considered one of the important books in the field of scientific research. The book covers multiple topics such as the science of scientific research, scientific thinking, the researcher and scientific research, concepts and terminology in scientific research, scientific research methods, historical research method, descriptive research method, and experimental research method. The book aims to present the basics of theoretical scientific research and its practical practice, making it a useful resource for researchers and students in the field of science.
descriptions.3181: This book by Imam Al-Shawkani deals with the topic of prohibiting everything that intoxicates the mind or slanders, based on Sharia evidence from the Qur’an and Sunnah. The author aims to explain the ruling on intoxicants and drugs in Islam, with a focus on the importance of preserving the mind, which the Shari’ah has made the basis of obligation. The book includes an analytical study of the work's life and methodology, in addition to an investigation of the original text of the thesis.
descriptions.3182: The book is concerned with studying innovations and violations in Hajj, as it provides a comprehensive analysis of these issues through sequential sections. Hajj is a fundamental pillar of Islam, and is an occasion for worship and drawing closer to God, but it has been exposed to various heresies and violations over time. The book aims to alert people and warn them against falling into these heresies and violations, in order to ensure the validity of worship and that they do not fall into forbidden things. The book provides a comprehensive study of heresies and violations in Hajj, and examines the definition of heresy, its types and categories, as well as the danger of innovation in religion and the evidence for its prohibition. The book constitutes an important reference for those interested in Hajj and Islamic worship, and provides a comprehensive vision on the importance of maintaining the health of worship and staying away from heresies and violations.
descriptions.3183: This book, “Forbidden and Forbidden Sales,” by Abdel Nasser bin Khader Milad, is considered a study in the field of legal transactions. It aims to address the subject of forbidden sales in Islamic jurisprudence, define its limits, and clarify its provisions.
